TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_HOARYBOULDER_000_06: That's the first time I've almost been knocked to the ground by a Lalafell! I've never seen Miss Tataru so determined. Has aught befell with which I might help, Antecedent?
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_070: Ah, not at present, thank you. ...Was there something you would ask of me?
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_HOARYBOULDER_000_07: Oh, yes! Pray excuse my distraction. An adventurer who was to join us for escort duty was injured while out on patrol.
And I fear we cannot properly defend the scholars entrusted to our protection without the aid of at least one more guard...
Therefore, I humbly request that another adventurer─of the capable kind, of course─be assigned to our party.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_074: Very well. I shall consider the potential candidates and provide you with a replacement as soon as I am able.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_HOARYBOULDER_000_07: My thanks, Antecedent. I take my leave of you.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_MINFILIA_000_000: The power to defend oneself...? Hmm. Tataru has ever been full of surprises.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_MINFILIA_000_001: Now that I think on it, I do recall Urianger mentioning that she had developed an interest in arcanima...
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_MINFILIA_000_002: Mayhap she hopes to gain admittance to the Arcanists' Guild in Limsa Lominsa? ...Yes, that will be the way of it.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_MINFILIA_000_003: Would you be so kind as to journey to the guild and see that all is well? It is doubtless unwarranted─but surely I am not alone in my concern for her safety?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_004: Has she already gone downstairs? Enthusiasm is well and good, but in excess... <sigh> I pray I was not wrong.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_011: I didn't mean for her to worry... That's the last thing I wanted.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_012: Putting an end to such worries is precisely the reason I'm here, don't you see?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_013: I, Tataru Taru, shall become a great and powerful arcanist!
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_014: And now, at Mistress Thubyrgeim's behest, I must go and complete a special training exercise! Until we meet again!
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_030: Ah, if it isn't . What brings you to the guild?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_031: ...So you are acquainted with our newest member. <sigh> An arcanist of your experience must see that her potential is somewhat lacking.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_032: Nevertheless, she would not be denied, and goes now to undertake her first trial: a simulated inspection of three crates. Doubtless you recall receiving similar training under K'lyhia's supervision?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_033: A thought occurs to me─why not oversee Tataru's training yourself? Given your relationship with the girl and your familiarity with the task, I think you the ideal choice. You need only head to the cliffs south of the Zephyr Gate, as before, and observe at a distance.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_040: Yes? How may I assist you, ?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_041: ...So you are acquainted with our newest member. <sigh> Mayhap you have already noticed, but I fear young Tataru's potential is somewhat lacking.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_042: Nevertheless, she would not be denied, and goes now to undertake her first trial: a simulated inspection of three crates. A simple task, some might say, but one all arcanists are expected to complete.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_043: A thought occurs to me─why not assist Tataru with her training? Given your relationship with the girl and your growing understanding of arcanima, you may prove a great help to her. Her trial will be conducted at the cliffs south of the Zephyr Gate. You need only observe at a distance.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_050: Greetings, and welcome to the Arcanists' Guild. Do you require assistance?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_051: ...So you are acquainted with our newest member. Hmm... I am sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but...I fear young Tataru may not be ideally suited to the study of arcanima.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_052: Nevertheless, she would not be denied, and goes now to undertake her first trial: a simulated inspection of three crates. A simple task, some might say, but one all arcanists are expected to complete.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_053: A thought occurs to me─why not supervise Tataru's training? You are clearly an accomplished adventurer, and given your relationship with the girl, you seem an ideal person to have on hand. Her trial will be conducted at the cliffs south of the Zephyr Gate. You need only observe at a distance.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_070:
O'er azure seas to pirates' port,♪
Where she met her shining jewel...♪
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_071:
For to bring the smugglers' plans to naught,♪
Came the lass whom none could fool!♪
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_072:
Beat 'em with a Backdraft!♪
Gut 'em with a Gust!♪
Deck 'em with a Downburst!♪
Go, Carbuncle, go!♪
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_073: O～hohoho! Are those crates I spy?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_074: Ah, and this must be the true test! But we're ready for them, aren't we, Carbuncle!?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_076: Uwaaah! Come back, Carbuncle! Come baaack!
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_091: You needn't say a word─your face says it all. I know you bore witness to my shame.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_092: <sniffle> Betrayed by my own Carbuncle and left at the mercy of wild beasts...
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_093: I...I must accept the truth. I'll never be a warrior like you or the others.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_094: I will inform Mistress Thubyrgeim of my intention to withdraw from the guild. Arcanima...like so much else...is beyond me.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_100: Ah, back so soon? How fared our fledgling arcanist?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_101: Abysmally, Mistress Thubyrgeim, abysmally─as  will testify.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_102: I was wrong to become an arcanist. Wrong as usual. I am completely and utterly unqualified, and I sincerely apologize for wasting your time.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_103: ...Tataru. If that were true, I would not have permitted you to join in the first place.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_104: We must all come to accept our limitations, lest our ambitions lead us astray. However, we must not lose sight of our strengths in the process.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_105: For example, your exceptional skill with numbers helped you to gain a solid grasp of the fundamentals of arcanima. Were it not so, you would have struggled even to summon Carbuncle to your side.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_106: In my opinion, the Scions are truly fortunate to have such a capable and good-natured receptionist in their service. Would you not agree?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_107: You are too kind, Mistress Thubyrgeim. Though I could not overcome this challenge, I shall take your words to heart and try not to be discouraged.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_000: <sigh> As fetching as these garments are, I fear I shall never don them again...
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_001: But I can't go back to the Rising Stones without something to show for my time away.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_002: Wait─I know what I can do! That is, if you don't mind accompanying me for a little longer?
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_003: Wonderful! Then to Costa del Sol we will go! It's a bit of a gamble, but I'm confident it will pay off!
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_THUBYRGEIM_000_004: Tataru is a bright, spirited girl. If she could but focus her nervous energy...
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_010: Yes, this is it! This is where the man at the Drowning Wench told me to look!
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_011: There is a certain variety of clam which can be harvested this time of year in Bloodshore─one which produces the most marvelous pearls!
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_012: However, these clams are also coveted by certain wild creatures─and since I fared rather poorly in battle last time... Ahem. Let us be off!
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_020: What fortune, I've already found one! Would you be so kind as to keep watch while I work? This should only take a moment...
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_021: Open...up...you little... Gah! This is proving more difficult than I thought...
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_030: Well fought, , well fought! I knew I was right to ask you to come.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_031: As for me, I have my prize: a bounty of blood pearls!
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_032: So named for their reddish hue, they were treasured as wards against dark magicks in ancient times.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_033: I thought I might make charms for everyone...so that no matter where they go, they will always come home.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_034: It's sort of the power to defend myself and other people...in a way. Right, well, I mustn't keep F'lhaminn waiting! There's work to be done─and lots of it!
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_035: We're to secure provisions for the Scions in the Lominsan markets. She may have an eye for quality, but I have a nose for bargains!
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_036: Will you be heading back to the Rising Stones? If so, pray convey my apologies to the Antecedent, and tell her that she needn't worry about me.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_037:
Farewell, , and thank you for everything!
Hmmm, that sounded rather final, didn't it? How about...until we meet again!
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_MINFILIA_000_050: Welcome home, . I gather you found Tataru in Limsa Lominsa?
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_MINFILIA_000_051: My, it sounds as though she had quite an adventure. And while it did not end as she had hoped, I suspect that it will prove to be a valuable experience.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_MINFILIA_000_052: I daresay she could have managed without our intervention. Even so, I appreciate you indulging my request.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_MINFILIA_000_060: My, it sounds as though she had quite an adventure. And while it did not end as she had hoped, I suspect that it will prove to be a valuable experience. I daresay she could have managed without our intervention. Even so, I appreciate you indulging my request.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_MINFILIA_000_061: I am sorry, . No doubt you have other matters to attend to, and we have already imposed upon you so much. Pray take some time for yourself─I daresay you have more than earned a respite.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_MINFILIA_000_062: After all, we will be most busy with preparations as the banquet draws near. Should other adventures summon you elsewhere, perhaps now is the time to heed their call?
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_SYSTEM_000_063: In order to progress in the main scenario, you must first complete certain quests in the Crystal Tower series.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_SYSTEM_000_070: The Crystal Tower quest series may be undertaken by speaking with the outlandish man in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_MINFILIA_000_000: I wonder, do you perchance recall the commitment I made to furnish Hoary Boulder with a capable adventurer? Well, I am sorry to say that I have as yet been unable to do so. Now, I realize that you are rather more than a “capable adventurer,” and that escort duty is frankly beneath a  of your talents...but I have no one else to turn to at present. Might you be willing to forgo rest and assist us in this matter?
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_MINFILIA_000_001: Generous to a fault. I thank you, .
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_MINFILIA_000_002:
Now, it seems only fair that I explain the import of the task in question...
For some time, our order has employed a handful of scholars to travel around Eorzea taking aetheric readings that we might better understand the impact of primal summonings.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_MINFILIA_000_003: Naturally, it behooves us to ensure our employees' safety, and so we ask the adventurers in our service to serve as escorts.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_MINFILIA_000_004: Hoary Boulder and Coultenet were to act as two such escorts, as was a third adventurer...
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_MINFILIA_000_005: Alas, due to injury, said adventurer is not presently fit for duty─hence my need to impose upon your goodwill.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_MINFILIA_000_006: You truly are a pillar of strength, .
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_MINFILIA_000_007: Hoary Boulder will share with you the details of your task. He should be waiting for you outside. Be safe.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_COULTENET_000_008: I had no idea that you would be assisting us personally, ! My sincerest apologies for dragging you into our affairs.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_HOARYBOULDER_000_01: Ah, ! Is it true that you agreed to lend us a hand?
Huzzah! What did I tell you, Coultenet? Our misfortune is become a blessing─an opportunity to serve alongside the Warrior of Light !
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_COULTENET_000_012: Need I remind you that we have three scholars to escort, each of whom will take a different route?
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_HOARYBOULDER_000_01: True, true─but our mission is the same! Separated by malms we may be, but in spirit we shall be together!
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_COULTENET_000_014: If such thoughts bring you joy, you are welcome to think them.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_COULTENET_000_015: To more practical concerns─, we would have you attend to the scholar charged with surveying the South Shroud.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_HOARYBOULDER_000_01: He is waiting at Camp Tranquil as we speak. All you need do is follow the man─he will determine the most appropriate locations to take his readings.
In spirit, ─in spirit, we shall be together every step of the way!
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_SCIENTIST00423_000_: At last, the Scions'  deigns to grace me with  presence. A pity that we have no time for pleasantries.
Our first destination is Issom-Har. Come─we are late enough as it is.
Yes, this location should suffice. Once I finish calibrating my instruments, I will require but a moment to take the necessary measurements.
I trust I need not explain that my work can suffer no interruptions? Then please─stand at an appropriate distance and keep watch for wild beasts.
You wish me to deliver my report to your masters in a timely fashion, yes? Then stand aside and let me work.

I see we have both completed our respective tasks. A satisfactory outcome. Though, if I could make one suggestion: you might try to dispatch your foes more quietly in future. I do not like to pick fault, but I really must be allowed to concentrate.
Now then, Snakemolt awaits. Shall we?
Right about...here, yes. As before, I would ask that you keep an eye out for dangerous beasts as I work.
Pray see to your duty, as I must to mine.
Fascinating. These readings are not at all what I expected...

...Though perhaps that should come as no surprise. I am not given to superstition, but there is a queer, almost blasphemous air hereabouts. Let us quit this place and return to Rootslake. We have one more site to survey.
As before, my guardian. Pray leave me to my task and ensure our safety.
Hm? No, I have not yet finished. Return to your watch.
This data should prove invaluable to─ <sniff> <sniff> Ye gods, what is that stench? Did you slaughter a creep of adamantoises while my back was turned!?
Quickly now, to Camp Tranquil! I will not have my clothing reeking of blood and offal!
Hm. You chose to paddle in the ichor awhile longer, I take it... No matter─I took advantage of my unexpected privacy and performed a cursory analysis of my data.
It would appear that there has been a measurable decrease in Eorzea's ambient aether concentrations since the Calamity...
However, this data is far from conclusive. We must take additional measurements to confirm my assessment.
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_SCIENTIST00423_000_: For our next survey, I would have you escort me to Urth's Fount.

The ambient aether concentrations there are so high that crystalline structures form spontaneously. Consequently, anomalous fluctuations should be much easier to detect. Brilliant, yes? No, don't bother answering─that was rhetorical. Now, come along!
You should be more than familiar with the procedure by now. Pray find a suitable position from which to keep watch while I take measurements.
We will be here all  if you do not leave me be, young !
Yes...yes...quite high, yet still markedly lower than the historical measurements taken near the end of the Sixth Astral Era...
Could the presence of a primal account for the difference? Or is there something else...something else...
Scion! Scion, come here! I-I need you!
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_HOARYBOULDER_000_01: Fear not, my friends! Help has arrived!
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_COULTENET_000_017: There you are, ! Hoary and I were worried when you and your charge failed to return at the appointed hour.
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_HOARYBOULDER_000_01: <sigh> Gutted like a hog...but not by one, no. These wounds were made with a blade... Doesn't look like he put up much of a fight, either. Nary a mark on his sword or his shield...
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_COULTENET_000_019: I've heard nothing of any Crystal Brave operations in this area. What cause had Wilred to come here?
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_COULTENET_000_021: We will see to the scholar's protection, .
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_HOARYBOULDER_000_02: Aye, and the boy's remains. You should return to the Rising Stones. The Antecedent will want to know what happened here.
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_SCIENTIST00423_000_: I've...I've never been this close to a...to a... Oh...oh gods...
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_HOARYBOULDER_000_03: We spoke a few times in the Rising Stones. He wasn't as experienced as some of the other Braves─but gods, he had passion...
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_COULTENET_000_032: Gods, what a waste... Pray leave matters here to us, . You must return to the Rising Stones and inform the Antecedent at once.
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_MINFILIA_000_040: , you are returned! And you seem troubled. Did the role of escort chafe so?
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_MINFILIA_000_041: Wilred...dead? Mayhap murdered? By the Twelve! How can that be!?
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_MINFILIA_000_042: I will send word to Alphinaud at once. He will want to conduct a full investigation, and send word to Wilred's family...
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_MINFILIA_000_043: Gods... He was just a boy. Who would do this─and why?
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_MINFILIA_000_050: Gods... He was just a boy. Who would do this─and why? ...But I am sorry, . Doubtless this weighs heavy on your heart...and we have already imposed upon you so much.
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_MINFILIA_000_051: Pray take some time for yourself─I daresay you have more than earned a respite. After all, we will be most busy with preparations as the banquet draws near. Should other adventures summon you elsewhere, perhaps now is the time to heed their call?
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_SYSTEM_000_052: In order to progress in the main scenario, you must first complete certain quests in the Crystal Tower series.
TEXT_GAIUSE612_00424_SYSTEM_000_060: The Crystal Tower quest series may be undertaken by speaking with the outlandish man in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_SYSTEM_100_000: In order to progress in the main scenario, you must first complete certain quests in the Crystal Tower series.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_SYSTEM_100_001: The Crystal Tower quest series may be undertaken by speaking with the outlandish man in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_MINFILIA_000_000: Though recent events weigh heavily on our minds, we must needs set them aside for now.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_MINFILIA_000_001: We are come to a defining moment in Eorzean history...
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_MINFILIA_000_002: The grand commemoration of our joint defense of Ishgard─the first time in fifteen long years that our people have stood side by side with our neighbors to the north to fight in common cause.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_MINFILIA_000_003: This may mark the true rebirth of the Eorzean Alliance. Failing that, it should at the very least serve to bring our nations closer together.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_MINFILIA_000_004: ...We have every reason to raise our voices in celebration, do we not?
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_MINFILIA_000_005: We have bested Dravanians and Ascians both. Against desperate odds, we have fought and won.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_MINFILIA_000_006: But the primals still plague us, and the Empire still plots our subjugation. And our triumphs, remarkable though they are, were bought at a terrible price.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_MINFILIA_000_007: Brave adventurers and allies, broken on the Steps of Faith. And before our eyes, in this very room, our dear friend Moenbryda...
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_MINFILIA_000_008: This is the victory we have wrought, and it is as bitter ashes in my mouth.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_MINFILIA_000_009: I would sooner stay here and invite those with more appetite to enjoy the feast in my stead.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_MINFILIA_000_010: Alas, it is a royal banquet, and all of our allies will be in attendance. It is our duty to present a united front, that we might serve as a beacon of hope to all...
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_MINFILIA_000_011: It seems I have no choice but to take my own advice.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_MINFILIA_000_012: I instructed the others to meet us in Ul'dah, that we might make our grand entrance together.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_MINFILIA_000_013: Unfortunately, I had to settle for leaving Tataru and Lhaminn a note. If they do not return quickly, they will have to settle for whatever leftovers I can smuggle out of the Fragrant Chamber...
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_RIOL_000_030: Off to the big soirée, ? Raise a glass for me, eh? ...Or not. You don't look best pleased, . Somethin' on yer mind?
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_RIOL_000_031: By the Navigator, Wilred's dead!? Godsdammit! They must know they've been rumbled...
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_RIOL_000_032: I mean, er... Sod it. 'Tis past time we had this talk. After our last conversation, I got to thinkin' about where certain funds were comin' from. So I had a dig around─on the quiet, like─an' sure enough, I found it.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_RIOL_000_033: Seems a fair bit o' coin's made its way into the Braves' coffers courtesy of a “Dodo Consortium”─a daft name for a business if ever I heard one, which is what first gave me an inklin' that somethin' weren't right.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_RIOL_000_034: So I went through the ledgers again, an' found another half-dozen donations from organizations with stupid bloody names. Didn't take long to find the common thread: all were owned by the Mirage Trust.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_RIOL_000_035: Oh, I'll give the bastard credit─he showed us up for the amateurs we are. Short o' callin' one o' his businesses the bloody “Bribery Consortium,” I don't know what more he could've done to mock our rules on financial contributions.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_RIOL_000_036: The gods only know how many men o' the 1st an' 3rd are takin' Teledji's coin. But now we know as some of 'em are, I'd wager me right eye they're the ones what did for Wilred.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_RIOL_000_037: The earnest young fool had taken to askin' the wrong kind o' questions. Bound to attract attention, he was... Should've seen it at the time─but I didn't, gods damn me...
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_RIOL_000_038: Still, I don't see what Teledji hopes to accomplish. He hid his scheme with all the care of a drunk pissin' into the wind...
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_RIOL_000_039: No, he's cleverer than this─so we need to be clever too. That's the only way we'll ever repay this debt o' blood.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_RIOL_000_040: We'll purge every one o' them traitorous bastards from our ranks! On that you have me word.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_RIOL_000_041: An' ─mind yerself when yer in Ul'dah, eh? We're headin' into a storm. I can smell it.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_RIOL_000_042: ...The kind what'll sweep a man overboard an' drag him under 'fore he knows it.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_YSHTOLA_000_060: If I did not know better, I should think our bard had run afoul of another jilted lover...
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_THANCRED_000_061: Is that...? No, just my imagination.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_THANCRED_000_062: Oh, pay no attention to me. 'Tis a habit from my misspent youth, looking over my shoulder from time to time.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_YDA_000_063: It's a banquet, so there'll definitely be food─but will there also be dancing? And if there is, will it be before or after the food? Dancing on a full stomach is no fun...but neither is being hungry... Hmm, what to do...
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_PAPALYMO_000_064: I do hope Yda is not under the impression that we are here to make merry. We are ostensibly the Antecedent's escort, after all.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_MINFILIA_000_070: We have been waiting for you, . The celebration is due to begin shortly.
TEXT_GAIUSE613_00425_MINFILIA_000_071: I had hoped that we might make our introductions together, but Mistress Momodi just sent word that you are needed at the Quicksand...
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_MINFILIA_000_000: We will go on ahead, . Pray join us once matters at the Quicksand are resolved.
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_THANCRED_000_001: Give my regards to Momodi, and let her know that I will call upon her anon.
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_YSHTOLA_000_002: If I did not know better, I should think our bard had run afoul of another jilted lover...
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_THANCRED_000_003: Is that...? No, just my imagination.
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_THANCRED_000_004: Oh, pay no attention to me. 'Tis a habit from my misspent youth, looking over my shoulder from time to time.
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_YDA_000_005: Food then dancing...or dancing then food? Or food then dancing then more food? Hmm...
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_PAPALYMO_000_006: I do hope Yda is not under the impression that we are here to make merry. We are ostensibly the Antecedent's escort, after all.
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_MOMODI_000_010: I appreciate you droppin' in on such short notice, . I know you've got places to be, so I won't waste your time.
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_MOMODI_000_011: You're friends with a Crystal Brave by the name of Alianne, aren't you? Former adventurer? Come to think of it, I'm pretty sure you recruited her yourself.
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_MOMODI_000_012: Well anyway, she came 'round for a meal not long ago, and before she left, she asked me to give you a message. Said if the others ended up draggin' you to the feast, I was to see you got it before you made your grand entrance.
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_MOMODI_000_013: “Meet me at the station west of the Coffer & Coffin. There's something I must show you.”
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_MOMODI_000_014: A short message, I'll grant you, but she thought long and hard before pickin' those words. Barely touched her food, too. Under other circumstances, I'd've thought those signs of a troubled heart, but somethin' tells me she ain't plannin' to .
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_MOMODI_000_015: Best not keep Alianne waitin'─or your friends at the feast, for that matter.
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_SYSTEM_000_020: As you stand upon the platform, your thoughts begin to wander...and all too soon, the ghosts of comrades lost and enemies slain begin to file by your mind's eye in solemn procession... Clearing your head, you scan the horizon, but see no sign of Alianne.
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_SYSTEM_000_030: Straining your ears to listen, you hear the chatter of Qiqirn and the buzzing of syrphids, but no approaching footfall. Sighing, you bow your head...only to notice the vial lying at your feet.
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_LAURENTIUS_000_040: , is that you? What brings you out this way?
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_LAURENTIUS_000_041: Lieutenant Alianne? Why no, I haven't seen her about...
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_LAURENTIUS_000_042: Had she come this way, I guarantee we would have crossed paths. I must have passed this spot a dozen times.
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_LAURENTIUS_000_043: We're to patrol the city's environs, on account of the royal banquet. Captain's orders, you understand. Speaking of which─isn't it about to begin?
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_LAURENTIUS_000_044: You should be with the other honored guests, enjoying your well-deserved respite. Aye, pray return to Ul'dah, . If I chance to meet the lieutenant, I will tell her you were here.
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_LAURENTIUS_000_050: Gods, I envy you. All that food and wine... But I cannot think of a  more deserving. Enjoy the feast, ─you've earned it.
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_MOMODI_000_060: I reckoned you'd head straight to the feast after meetin' with Alianne. What's the matter? No appetite?
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_MOMODI_000_061: ...So she wasn't there, but this was, eh? Let's see...
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_MOMODI_000_062: Hmmm...looks to me like an alchemist's vial, but beyond that, I can't say. Might be best if you hold on to it for safekeepin', though.
TEXT_GAIUSE614_00426_MOMODI_000_063: Anyroad, no use worryin' about Alianne. I'm sure she'll turn up before too long, and when she does, we'll soon find out what this was all in aid of. Besides─you've got more important things to think about.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_MOMODI_100_000: Would you believe that, while you were away, another message arrived for you? Well, one did.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_MOMODI_100_001: One delivered by the sultana's handmaiden, no less. Seems Her Grace desires a private audience.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_MOMODI_100_002:
Her handmaiden will meet you on the Royal Promenade and escort you to the sultana's chambers.
...So what are you waitin' for? Go on, then! Go!
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_MOMODI_100_003: I don't know about you, but if the sultana summoned me for a private meetin', I'd be practicin' my curtsy on the Royal Promenade by now! OUT!
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_BARTHOLOMEW_100_004: Greetings, . The banquet began mere moments ago, and I would be honored to show you in─but I believe that the sultana's handmaiden has an urgent matter to discuss with you. My apologies, .
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_LADYINWAITING00427_: Thank you for coming, . Her Grace is most eager to speak with you.
If you require a moment to compose yourself before your audience, you may have it. Or, if you are ready, it would be my honor to escort you to Her Grace's chambers forthwith.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_SYSTEM_100_011: Upon proceeding to the sultana's bedchamber, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_SYSTEM_100_012: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_BREMONDT_000_000: Them soldiers'll keep searchin' for a while yet. Reckon we'll take the carriage back towards Ul'dah an' get the lay of the land─maybe provide a distraction if need be.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_BREMONDT_000_001: You three wait here. Help'll be along shortly. Stay strong, friends─the real fight's to come!
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_ALPHINAUD_000_020: How could I have been so blind...
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_PIPPIN_000_030: The most unassuming folk can prove to be our greatest allies. That fellow was but a passing merchant, yet he lent us aid without a moment's hesitation─or any hint of concern for his own safety.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_PIPPIN_000_031: Though I can well imagine how a man could feel inspired to risk all in your presence.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_PIPPIN_000_032: Father spoke often of you, , and long have I looked forward to our first meeting. Needless to say...this is not at all how I envisioned it.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_PIPPIN_000_033: Master Alphinaud, you must not give in to despair. That would only play into our enemies' hands! So long as you and  are free, we may still set things right.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_ALPHINAUD_000_034: Forgive me, Marshal Tarupin, but I─
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_CID_000_035: (-???-)Alphinaud, my boy─sorry to keep you waiting!
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_ALPHINAUD_000_036: Cid? What are you doing here?
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_CID_000_037: Pulling you out of the fire, as usual! Your merchant friend told me everything.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_PIPPIN_000_038: Truly? Then he is no merchant but an angel in peddlers' clothing... But tell us─how do you intend to bear our friends to safety?
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_CID_000_039: I hid the Enterprise but a short distance away. All I need is a destination.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_PIPPIN_000_040: We must find a place beyond the reach of both the Monetarists and the Crystal Braves...
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_ALPHINAUD_000_041: ...Coerthas. Ishgard will not suffer the intrusion of foreign forces in their territory.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_CID_000_042: That settles it. With me, everyone!
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_PIPPIN_000_043: Not I, I fear. I must remain here. I dare not abandon Ul'dah to the Monetarists and their cronies.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_PIPPIN_000_044: You may be certain that they will seek to defame you, both here and in the other city-states. But know that I shall do my utmost to thwart their every effort.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_PIPPIN_000_045: Frankly, I do not expect it to be much of a challenge. The smallfolk will not turn so easily on the Warrior of Light and  allies, no matter what the Monetarists claim.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_ALPHINAUD_000_046: Marshal Tarupin, I...I know not what to say.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_PIPPIN_000_047: Hah! Now that Father would labor to believe! But enough talk─you must go, Master Alphinaud. Your airship awaits!
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_CID_000_050: Up, up! There's no rest for the righteous!
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_ALPHINAUD_000_060: We should make for Camp Dragonhead and speak with Lord Haurchefant. Mayhap...mayhap he will know what to do.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Lord Haurchefant has agreed to grant us succor. He says that we will be safe here...
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_YAELLE_000_071: You are among friends here. Pray take your ease and turn your thoughts to better days.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_HAURCHEFANT_000_080: Master Alphinaud told me your tale, . It warms my heart that you should turn to me before all others─and I shall endeavor to deserve your trust.
TEXT_GAIUSE615_00427_HAURCHEFANT_000_081: Alas...the situation here has grown more complicated in your absence. 'Twould be best if I explained in full.
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_ALPHINAUD_000_010: ...Who managed to escape? And what of those who did not?
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_HAURCHEFANT_000_011: The intercessory awaits, . Pray do not keep your companions in suspense. I am certain their hearts will soar at the sight of you!
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_FORTEMPSGUARD00428_: Greetings, . Shall I show you inside?
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_SYSTEM_000_021: Upon proceeding to the intercessory, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_SYSTEM_000_022: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_TATARU_000_041: I...I'm so happy that...that you are... <sniffle> <sob>
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_TATARU_000_042: I tried contacting Minfilia and the others, but no one would respond...
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_TATARU_000_043: And then Crystal Braves─our own people!─turned on us in the marketplace.
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_TATARU_000_044: F'lhaminn told me to run, and so I did. I ran and I ran until my lungs burned and my feet ached... But I lost my way...and then...
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_YUGIRI_000_045: (-???-)Fortunately, I had observed some of the Braves behaving suspiciously beforehand.
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_YUGIRI_000_046: Hm? Ah, yes, my mask─it was lost in the struggle.
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_TATARU_000_048: Anyway, after Yugiri found me, we traveled to Vesper Bay and met up with Urianger. When we told him what had happened, he used his magicks to weave a glamour around the Waking Sands. From the outside, our old headquarters now looks like an abandoned storehouse!
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_TATARU_000_049: The transformation didn't take long, either. Apparently, Urianger started making preparations after the imperial attack, just in case the Empire ever chose to pay us another visit. Good thinking, eh!?
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_TATARU_000_050: Sorry, where was I? Oh yes, so we waited there at the Waking Sands, hoping others would come...but no one else did.
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_YUGIRI_000_051: My people are searching for the other Scions even as we speak, but we have met with no success as yet. I had hoped that you might be able to suggest further places to look. Ah, but you should know, the Rising Stones did not share the Waking Sands' good fortune. Only Crystal Braves await you there.
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_YUGIRI_000_052: Be that as it may, we yet have cause to hope, do we not? If the two of you escaped, it is not impossible that the others could have done so as well.
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_YUGIRI_000_053: You may have been forsaken by men and women believed true, but rest assured that the people of Doma yet stand with you. We welcome this opportunity to repay our debts, and shall continue our efforts to locate the others and see the Scions restored to their rightful place of honor.
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_LAHABREAANCIENT_000: (-Lahabrea-)The Ardor was not his to invoke. His demise was of his own making.
(-Lahabrea-)Nevertheless, it concerns me. They have...extinguished that which should rightly be eternal.
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_ELIDIBUSANCIENT_000: (-Elidibus-)Mayhap he was not wholly mistaken. Greater haste may be warranted.
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_LAHABREAANCIENT_000: (-Lahabrea-)The earth is fertile, and the seeds well sown. By my will, they shall reap salvation unlike any the world has known.
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_URIANGER_000_079: I have answered thy summons, Emissary. Speak and make thine intent known.
TEXT_GAIUSE616_00428_ELIDIBUSEORZEA_000_: (-Elidibus-)I would speak of fate, Archon. Yours, mine─the fate of this very star.
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_MINFILIA_000_002: As Moenbryda was a native of Sharlayan, I feel it is only fitting that we gather before the mark of the Scholar. Are you familiar with the stone?
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_MINFILIA_000_003: 'Tis a monument found at Rathefrost, and is sacred to Thaliak, guardian deity of the city of learning.
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_MINFILIA_000_004: There shall we pray for our dear friend's soul, and bid her a peaceful return to the light of the Mothercrystal.
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_YDA_100_010: Oh, Moen... I miss you so much already...
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_PAPALYMO_100_011: She was counting on the theory that a soul's aether burns brightest at the moment of its passing. A scholar until the very end...
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_THANCRED_100_012:
Would we had arrived a few moments sooner...
Just a few moments...
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_YSHTOLA_100_013: Our list of grievances against the Ascians was already overlong. Must they continue to add to it?
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_YDA_000_010: I don't want to believe she's really gone...
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_PAPALYMO_000_011: The loss of those close to you is never easy...and Yda was closer to Moenbryda than most.
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_THANCRED_000_012: As ever, I was a step too late...
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_YSHTOLA_000_013: Was there aught we might have done to save her? 'Tis foolish to torture oneself with such thoughts, but the heart is ofttimes deaf to quiet reason.
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_MINFILIA_000_014: Moenbryda showed us the way forward at the cost of her own life. What worth is her sacrifice if we do not follow where it leads?
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_MINFILIA_000_015: Let us gather at Rathefrost, and show our respects for our fallen comrade. Then we shall continue with the work she began...
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_YDA_000_020: I don't feel much like talking at the moment. If you could just...give me some time.
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_PAPALYMO_000_021: I loathe to see Yda in such pain, but I have not the words to comfort her. Can you imagine it? I, Papalymo, the one who has an eloquent comment for every situation, am at a loss for words...
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_THANCRED_000_022: We must find some means of protecting ourselves from Ascian intrusions. There must be a way...
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_YSHTOLA_000_023: The Rising Stones feels somehow colder. Moenbryda always carried with her such an abundance of warmth and cheer.
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_MINFILIA_200_030: Though we have said our farewells, the pall of sadness has diminished but little. Forgive me: as Antecedent, 'tis my job to be the pillar of strength for all others to lean upon.
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_MINFILIA_300_030: Yet I also believe the grief we feel now is precious in its own way, and not to be lightly swept aside. Do you not agree, ?
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_MINFILIA_000_030: 'Tis as if a dagger has been thrust into my breast...
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_MINFILIA_100_030: But 'tis a pain we must learn to bear if we are to forge ahead with our duty.
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_MINFILIA_000_031: The battles we have fought have taken the lives of so many. Louisoix. Moenbryda. Our fellows at the Waking Sands.
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_MINFILIA_000_032: Their spirit and dedication to our cause, however, will never be lost as long as we rise to fight once more.
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_MINFILIA_000_033: I hardly need remind you of this, of course. 'Tis for my own benefit that I repeat these words─a reaffirmation of mine own chosen path.
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_MINFILIA_000_034: If I do not rebuild the foundation of my resolve, I am like to collapse in a fit of weeping...
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_MINFILIA_000_035: My apologies again, ─there is no other to whom I could display such weakness.
TEXT_GAIUSE508_00429_MINFILIA_000_036: You are my pillar of strength, and I fear I shall have need of your steadfast presence in the days to come...
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_MINFILIA_000_000: ...Hm? . It pleases me to see you well.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_TATARU_000_001: Do excuse me for interrupting, . My lady, the gentleman from Ashgana Exports has just left.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_TATARU_000_002: <sigh> I understand now why you didn't want to receive him.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_MINFILIA_000_003: You did well, Tataru. Please inform the guards that we will not be receiving any further guests this .
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_MINFILIA_000_005: Ever since we defeated Gaius van Baelsar and destroyed his ultimate weapon, the eyes of the world have followed our every move, scarce remembering to blink.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_MINFILIA_000_006: Where once we worked in secret─with precious few friends and all too many enemies─we are now besieged by benefactors, each one more eager than the last to offer us his complete support.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_MINFILIA_000_008: Of course, every promise of patronage comes with a price.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_MINFILIA_000_009: Some make their intentions known from the start, while others endeavor to engage us more subtly. Dress it how they will, the message is ever the same: we shall help you, but only if you help us.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_MINFILIA_000_010: The gentleman Tataru spoke of was more brazen than most. In exchange for certain supplies, he would have us resolve a business dispute.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_MINFILIA_000_011: Naturally, I refused him, as I have every other merchant of his ilk... Alas, the Syndicate's overtures are not so easily rejected...
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_MINFILIA_000_012: When we formed the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, it was with the goal of serving Eorzea, not the interests of individual Eorzeans. Our neutrality is fundamental to our cause.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_MINFILIA_000_013: In my heart, I know this to be true, and yet... And yet... If accepting these offers of patronage could empower us to do greater good, might they not warrant greater consideration?
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_MINFILIA_000_014: Our Baldesion colleagues have been generous beyond measure, but we cannot expect them to─
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_MINFILIA_000_015: Forgive me. I did not mean to burden you so.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_MINFILIA_000_016: Yet...my urge to share this dilemma may not be wholly misguided... Might I impose upon you to consult the others? They are like to have their own opinions on this matter.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_MINFILIA_000_017: I confess, I am...conflicted. It may be wise to consult with the others.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_THANCRED_000_020: Fortune begets power, and power fortune. That we─and especially you─have power is beyond doubt. The question is what to do with it...
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_THANCRED_000_021: You may be interested to know that there is a growing belief amongst the refugees that Ala Mhigo could be liberated...if only the Scions would commit their strength to the cause.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_THANCRED_000_022: Yet theirs is but one of many causes. We stand at a crossroads, . Each path is paved with good intentions, but where they lead is far from clear.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_YSHTOLA_100_022: Recall you our meeting with the Admiral, shortly after the Lominsans sent word of the summoning of Titan?
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_YSHTOLA_101_022: Then mayhap you also recall my words to our host. I said unto Merlwyb that her people had broken their treaty with the kobolds, and that the beastmen had justly responded─that we had been called to intervene in a conflict which she herself had invited. I spoke, in short, the truth.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_YSHTOLA_102_022: And wherefore did I speak it? Because, owing no allegiance to Limsa, I felt no compulsion to allow the Lominsans to distort the facts to fit a narrative which justified their actions and absolved them of guilt.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_YSHTOLA_103_022: Upon this subject, Minfilia can expect a similar reply. Our many dalliances with the city-states have already weakened our claim to neutrality, but the path she contemplates would see us relinquish it entirely.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_PAPALYMO_000_030: None can deny that we would benefit from more support, but if it comes at the cost of our principles?
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_PAPALYMO_000_031: Neutrality was ever a delicate matter. I've lost count of the times I've had to explain to people that our allegiances need not necessarily lie in the same place as our headquarters. Mind you, if we are to sell our services for gil, we might as well declare our fealty to Ul'dah now, and have done with it. I'm quite sure Yda would enjoy the bribes...
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_YDA_000_040: I've been receiving a lot of gifts lately, but Papalymo keeps making me send them back.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_YDA_000_041: It wouldn't be so bad, but some of them are really nice! I mean, very nearly abandon-your-principles nice, you know?
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_URIANGER_000_050: 'Tis the lot of the powerful to attract the covetous as well as the needy. Thus doth prudence dictate that those with power proffer aid with one hand whilst the other resteth ever on their hilt.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_URIANGER_000_051: Alas, we have not the luxury of time to decipher our petitioners' machinations─nay, not while the beast tribes do labor unseen, defiant in defeat, to raise up their fallen primals once more.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_URIANGER_000_052: Doubt not that they shall return─stronger and bolder both─nor that we shall be the ones to meet them. This sacred charge shall ever be ours. 'Tis but a pity we are so few, and our fortune so finite...
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Hm. This situation is not wholly unexpected.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_061: I too have given much thought to our organization's future...though it would seem I have reached a different conclusion.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_062: Mayhap it is time I made my feelings known to the Antecedent. Come along, .
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_064: You desired counsel, and so you shall have it. Minfilia─the Scions of the Seventh Dawn must leave Ul'dah.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_066: So long as we remain within Ul'dahn territory, we will never be free to act with impunity.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_067: Moving our headquarters to Vesper Bay only delayed the inevitable.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_068: We have demonstrated our capabilities, and the Syndicate has taken note. They will not suffer our organization to remain independent now. We are far too dangerous for that.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_069: Surely you realize they are the reason Vesper Bay still lacks an aetheryte?
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_070: They know full well how beneficial one would be to our cause...
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_071: Which is why it and other favors will be denied us unless we cooperate.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_MINFILIA_000_072: If Ul'dah is no longer suitable, where would you have us go?
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_073: Experience has taught us that the appearance of neutrality is as important as the reality.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_074: Accordingly, we must keep each of the great nations at arm's length, and plant our banner in a place which all agree to be beyond their borders.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_076: Revenant's Toll, to be precise. It lies within neutral territory, and offers all the essential facilities we require. By way of an additional benefit, it is also frequented by a veritable legion of adventurers who may serve to supplement our ranks.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_077: I am, of course, conscious of the fact that we have developed a certain bond with Ul'dah and her people over the years...
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_078: But I truly believe this to be the best course of action.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_MINFILIA_000_079: As you yourself observed, we have invaluable ties to the local community, forged through years of concerted effort. Ul'dah...Ul'dah is our home, Alphinaud! To cast aside everything we have built and start anew in that desolate wasteland would be beyond reckless!
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_080: The decision is yours to make, Antecedent. I ask only that you recall the shared purpose which first moved us to found the Scions of the Seventh Dawn─and which moved you to found the Path of the Twelve ere that.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_081: We aspire to an ideal, you and I. Just as my grandfather did. That makes us more than mere comrades-in-arms.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_082: We are as much your family as─
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_MINFILIA_000_084: I am sure you have some familial affairs of your own to attend to.
TEXT_GAIUSE101_01175_ALPHINAUD_000_085: Your concern is most generous, but no─I have left them in the hands of men better suited to the task than I. I could not very well allow my personal affairs to come before the needs of the order, after all.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_VORSAILE_000_000: Not long ago, the moogle Kuplo Kopp visited the Adders' Nest to request an audience with the Elder Seedseer.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_VORSAILE_100_000: He spoke of an imminent threat to all mooglekind, one which would imperil the entire Twelveswood if left unchecked.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_VORSAILE_000_001: You proved an able ambassador to the sylphs, and we would have you reprise the role in our dealings with the moogles.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_VORSAILE_000_002: The rest you should hear from Kuplo Kopp himself. He awaits you with the Elder Seedseer at the Lotus Stand.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_DOORMANLOTUS_000_01: The other Scions have already arrived, . May I show you in?
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_RAYAOSENNA_000_015: Our guest has brought ill tidings which must needs be heeded. Isn't that right, Kuplo Kopp?
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_KUPLOKOPP_000_016: Oh, I don't know about this. I don't know about this at all... <sigh> But I suppose Raya-O's right─they've left us no choice, kupo.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_PAPALYMO_000_017: A threat to mooglekind... Hmph. I had hoped the Antecedent's suspicions were ill founded, but I cannot see who else it could be...
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_YDA_000_018: It must be something bad to have gotten Kuplo Kopp this worried. Have you seen the way his thingummy is bobbing?
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_KUPLOKOPP_000_020: Please, you have to stop them! B-But you mustn't kill them! They're not bad moogles, kupo! They're just...misguided! A gentle─no, firm thrashing is in order, yes, but no─
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_RAYAOSENNA_000_021:
Calm yourself, Kuplo Kopp! Can you not see that  hasn't the faintest idea what you're talking about!? Be quiet this instant!
Pray forgive his witless outburst, Sister.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_KANESENNA_000_022: Most grateful am I that you have come, , and upon such short notice. Truly, Gridania could not wish for a more stalwart ally.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_KANESENNA_000_023: But you are doubtless eager to know wherefore we summoned you. Our friend Kuplo Kopp has brought to us news of a most unsettling development.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_KANESENNA_000_024: It would seem that Good King Moggle Mog XII has returned to Eorzea.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_RAYAOSENNA_000_025: A curious thing to hear, I know. Truth to tell, I myself cannot say for sure if he is a genuine figure from history or some manifestation of moogle mythology. Kuplo here would have me believe the former.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_KUPLOKOPP_000_026: Once upon a time, we moogles served the gods in the heavens. It was quite nice up there─unspeakably beautiful, unimaginably spacious, and with a literally endless supply of wine, kupo!
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_KUPLOKOPP_000_027: In spite of this, or possibly because of the last part, the gods eventually became discontented and started squabbling, which made life jolly difficult for the poor moogles.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_KUPLOKOPP_000_028: So Good King Moggle Mog XII─may his glorious name live forever─decreed that the time had come to leave, kupo! The realm of man would suffice, he said, so all the moogles should live there instead.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_KUPLOKOPP_000_029: Unfortunately, the two realms are so far apart that we couldn't safely fly down. But Good King Moggle Mog XII─may his miraculous foresight ever be praised─knew exactly what to do, kupo! He had a rope, you see─the longest one ever woven. This he nobly held while his subjects climbed all the way down to the world below.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_KUPLOKOPP_000_030: And that is how we moogles came to this land, kupo! All of us except Good King Moggle Mog XII─may his courageous sacrifice never be forgotten. He alone would remain in the heavens so that mooglekind might at last know peace.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_PAPALYMO_000_031: Except that he has not remained in the heavens, from what I understand─that being your reason for contacting us, yes?
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_YDA_000_032: I'll bet he tied the rope to something! Good thinking! Remind me again what the problem was with him returning to Eorzea?
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_KANESENNA_000_033: The problem, Yda, lies in the fact that he was summoned.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_KANESENNA_000_034: It is our belief that Good King Moggle Mog XII is a myth made manifest via means akin to those employed by the beast tribes in the summoning of their gods.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_YDA_000_035: Waaait... You're saying a handful of moogles with a boatload of crystals wished really, really hard, and he just sort of appeared? ...Would that even work?
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_PAPALYMO_000_036: What I cannot fathom is why they would even try.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_PAPALYMO_000_037: With Garuda humbled and the Ultima Weapon destroyed, what new threat could have prompted them to take so drastic a measure?
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_RAYAOSENNA_000_038: Might that not in itself be the answer? Twice in the last half decade, Eorzea has been brought unto the very brink of destruction, only to be spared at the last by the heroics of a chosen few.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_RAYAOSENNA_000_039: To you who braved those tempests and survived by virtue of your own strength, this latest period of peace will doubtless seem a welcome respite.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_RAYAOSENNA_000_040: But to those who had not the power to defend themselves, who were spared only by another's grace, this is merely the calm before the storm.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_RAYAOSENNA_000_041: I think the Mogglesguard are afraid─afraid of what tomorrow will bring, and that things may not end so well as they did yesterday.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_RAYAOSENNA_000_042: That fear has driven them to call upon a greater power, one they believe can be relied upon to protect their loved ones and their homes come what may.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_KUPLOKOPP_000_043: I assure you, the Mogglesguard only want to protect the forest from outsiders. But ever since the return of Good King Moggle Mog XII─may his boundless grace fill our hearts with love─they've started to get a little carried away, kupo. Verging on a lot, in fact...
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_YDA_000_044: Like the sylphs who summoned Ramuh, you mean?
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_PAPALYMO_000_045: Hmm. We cannot discount the possibility that this...entity is influencing the moogles in a manner similar to that of a primal.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_KANESENNA_000_051: Whoever or whatever the king may be, it is our belief that he poses a threat not only to mooglekind, but to Gridania as a whole. Thus do we beseech you, ─confront Good King Moggle Mog XII and drive him from our midst.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_KANESENNA_000_053: The sanctuary of the Mogglesguard and their liege lord is concealed by magical wards. Brother E-Sumi-Yan of the Conjurers' Guild will doubtless be able to offer insight on how they might be dispelled. Pray seek his counsel ere you proceed any further.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_KANESENNA_000_060: If you are to confront Good King Moggle Mog XII, you must needs find a way to defeat his magical defenses. Upon such matters, Brother E-Sumi-Yan is something of an authority. Pray consult him without delay.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_RAYAOSENNA_000_061: My sister is right, . For the moogles' sakes─and our own─banish the king from the Twelveswood.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_KUPLOKOPP_000_062:
Remember: no killing, kupo! A sound thrashing will more than suffice!
Oh dear, oh dear...
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_DOORMANLOTUS_000_06: The Seedseers pray for your success, as do I.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_ESUMIYAN_000_070: Welcome, . Welcome. That you should be the one to face Good King Moggle Mog XII is of great comfort─to me and to the elementals, both.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_ESUMIYAN_000_071: As I am sure you know, the moogles are not by their nature a warlike race. Yet should the king be suffered to remain, it is like that his influence will bring about a change in them.
TEXT_GAIUSE115_01189_ESUMIYAN_000_072: Thus does it behoove us to defeat him quickly, before any lasting damage is done. Make whatever preparations you deem necessary and inform me when you are ready to seek the king.
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_ESUMIYAN_000_000: The wards barring access to the king's sanctuary can only be nullified through the use of enchanted keystones─the selfsame method employed five years ago, when first the king was summoned to Eorzea.
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_ESUMIYAN_000_001: It was with great regret that we were forced to sanction the slaying of the guardians who then held the keystones, for none were in our possession at the time. By the grace of the elementals, however, we have been spared that burden on this occasion.
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_ESUMIYAN_100_001: Kuplo Kopp confided in me that he had been entrusted with a set of keystones by the Mogglesguard themselves. Yet wishing not to betray their confidence, he begged me to find some other means to gain entry to the king's sanctum.
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_ESUMIYAN_000_002: Alas, I have been unable to do so, and dare not labor any longer, for fear that the moogles might succumb to the corrupting influence of their liege lord. We must needs have Kuplo Kopp's keystones, . Pray go to him, and beg his assistance.
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_ESUMIYAN_000_003: He awaits you at Westshore Pier. Impress upon him our great need, and I am certain he will yield.
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPLOKOPP_000_010:
So? How will you do it, kupo?
...Oh, he told you about that.
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPLOKOPP_000_011: Well, if there truly is no other way... I'll do it, kupo. Take the ferry to Sweetbloom Pier─I'll go on ahead.
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPTAKAPA_000_020: Don't you dare lie to me, kupo! I know what you're planning, and I won't allow it!
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPLOKOPP_000_021: Open your eyes, kupo! The king will never be satisfied, no matter how many crystals you bring him!
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPLIKIPP_000_022: We offered you a choice, and this is how you repay us!? By consorting with this !?
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPTAKAPA_000_023: Imperials, Gridanians, sylphs─you're no different from the rest of them! Actually─you're worse, kupo!
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPLIKIPP_000_024: Traitor to his kinsmoogles! He plots treason against the crown!
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPDIKOOP_000_025: Enough! Kuplo Kopp will answer for his crimes soon enough, as will all who defy the will of Good King Moggle Mog XII─may he reign forevermore, kupo!
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPLOKOPP_000_026: The king is planning to purge the Twelveswood of his enemies, kupo! We've got to stop him before it's too late!
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPLOKOPP_000_027: The entrance to Thornmarch is deep within the Bramble Patch, kupo! If you take me there, I can nullify the ward. But be warned: the Mogglesguard has set traps to lure enchanted beasts. I can't hide from them, so you'll need to protect me, kupo!
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_SYSTEM_000_027: Escort Kuplo Kopp safely to the warded entrance. Should you fail to defend him, or move too far away, he will return to Sweetbloom Pier, where you may rendezvous with him before trying again.
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_SYSTEM_000_028: To face Good King Moggle Mog XII, you must successfully escort Kuplo Kopp to the warded entrance. Return to Sweetbloom Pier and speak with Kuplo Kopp to begin once more.
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_SYSTEM_100_028: You have lost sight of Kuplo Kopp. Retrace your steps to find them, then escort them safely to the warded entrance.
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPLOKOPP_000_028: (-Kuplo Kopp-)We're here, kupo! I don't see any more beasts, do you?
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_SYSTEM_001_028: You have reached your destination, and may end the escort mission if you so choose.
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_SYSTEM_002_028: If you do so, any party members who have not reached the destination with you will have their mission judged a failure.
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_SYSTEM_003_028: Be sure to confirm the whereabouts of your party members before ending the mission.
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPLOKOPP_000_030: Are you ready to face the king, kupo? Then step closer to the ward.
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPLOKOPP_000_031: Raise your hand and focus─like when you attune to an aetheryte, kupo! I'll open the way for you!
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPLOKOPP_000_040: The rest is up to you, kupo! Now go and teach those foolish moogles a lesson and send the king back whence he came!
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPLOKOPP_000_041: If anyone can slay Good King Moggle Mog XII─may he justly reign till the end of days─and save the Twelveswood from his wrath, it's you, kupo!
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPLOKOPP_000_050: You did it, kupo! You did it! Good King Moggle Mog XII─may his mighty soul rest in peace─is no more!
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPLOKOPP_000_051: I shudder to think what might've happened had you not stopped the Mogglesguard when you did. Thank you, .
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPLOKOPP_000_052: Perhaps now they'll come to their senses and stop playing at faerie tales. Rest assured that the chieftain will have choice words for them too!
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPLOKOPP_000_053: You should go and tell Pukni Pakk that the king is no more, kupo! She's with Raya-O at Camp Tranquil, and can relay the news to the chieftain.
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPCHAKUPA_000_060: Do I dare believe my ears!? Good King Moggle Mog XII─may his magnificent virtue serve as an example to us all─has fallen!?
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPCHAKUPA_000_061: All mooglekind owes you a debt, kupo! Ah, and I sense Raya-O wishes to congratulate you as well. I shall let you two speak without fear of interruption.
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPTAKAPA_000_100: Kupo!? Who in the seven hells are they!?
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_KUPDIKOOP_000_102: Mogglesguard, to arms! Defend the king, kupo!
TEXT_GAIUSE116_01190_POP_MESSAGE: You sense a hostile presence, kupo!
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_RAYAOSENNA_000_000: Your bravery in service to the Twelveswood and her moogles shall not be forgotten, .
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_RAYAOSENNA_000_001: My sister will doubtless wish to hear the tale of this great victory from the mouth of the  responsible. Pray return to the Lotus Stand and treat her to a full account of the day's events, while the details are yet fresh in your mind.
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_RAYAOSENNA_000_005: I know only too well how modest you are... If you take no pleasure in recounting your deeds, pray think instead of the pleasure others take from hearing about them. Surely that is motivation enough for one so selfless? Good! Off to the Lotus Stand with you.
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_DOORMANLOTUS_000_01: The Elder Seedseer is expecting you, . May I show you in?
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_YDA_000_010: ! Kuplo Kopp says you killed the king! I'm pleased, of course, but it completely spoiled the end of your story. Silly moogle.
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_PAPALYMO_000_010: By Louisoix's definition, the late King Moggle Mog XII was indeed a primal. But how can that be? It defies all precedent.
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_KUPLOKOPP_000_010: Everyone wants to hear your tale, kupo! What are you waiting for? Tell them! Tell them!
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_KANESENNA_000_011: . You are returned to us, unharmed and victorious. Thus have I two reasons to be glad.
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_KANESENNA_000_012: Yet many questions remain unanswered. If you would be so kind as to oblige me, I would fain hear all that occurred in Thornmarch.
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_YDA_000_014: The king really is a primal...
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_YDA_000_015: ...But he really isn't, is he? I mean, the moogles don't worship him, for one thing─he's not even a god to them! That doesn't sound like any primal I've ever heard of.
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_PAPALYMO_000_016: Then mayhap the fault lies with the definition. The fact remains that through a combination of the power contained in crystals and the force of their collective faith, the moogles called forth a being that by rights should not exist. Moreover, when slain, said being left no corpse─the aether which comprised him instead being scattered to the four winds.
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_KANESENNA_000_017: According to the accepted definition, he may not be a primal...but the mode of his manifestation was in every respect the same.
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_PAPALYMO_000_018: Ascians. This whole business reeks of their handiwork!
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_KUPLOKOPP_000_019: Kupopo!? They...they said it was a masked man who had taught them how, years ago─b-but Gridania has no shortage of masked men, and...and I never thought to question...
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_PAPALYMO_000_020: Confound it all! How many more will they ensnare with their tainted gifts...?
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_KANESENNA_000_021: Too many, I fear. So long as there are Paragons to stir the embers, fools to build the pyre, and crystals to feed the flames, ever and again shall we suffer primal visitation. A somber thought, but a salutary one.
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_KANESENNA_000_022: My heartfelt thanks, . Already, the information you have provided has proven invaluable. The grand serpent marshal and I have much to discuss.
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_YDA_000_023: Oh! Before you do, my lady, I was hoping we might finish discussing that other matter?
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_KANESENNA_000_024: The matter of which you speak has even now been settled. The Scions shall not want for support. We shall be glad to send additional supplies to Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_YDA_000_025: We knew we could count on you, my lady!
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_PAPALYMO_000_026: While Yda and I remain to discuss the particulars of our arrangement with the Elder Seedseer, mayhap you could return to the Waking Sands and apprise the Antecedent of all that has transpired?
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_YDA_000_027: Thanks to the Elder Seedseer's generous donation, the Rising Stones may actually be worth leaving the Waking Sands for!
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_PAPALYMO_000_028: This business has taught us much, and the Antecedent must needs be informed of our findings. Pray leave matters here to us and return to the Waking Sands.
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_KUPLOKOPP_000_029: You don't have to worry about the Mogglesguard anymore, kupo! The chieftain made them apologize in front of absolutely everyone. And just to be sure, we're keeping a close eye on them, too.
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_DOORMANLOTUS_000_03: May the elementals see you safely home, .
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_KANESENNA_100_030: Please extend my personal thanks to the Antecedent, along with my best wishes for the Scions' forthcoming move.
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_MINFILIA_000_030: It is good to see you hale and healthy, . I received word from Yda and Papalymo that you had felled Good King Moggle Mog XII, but I had hoped to hear your version of the tale.
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_MINFILIA_000_031: ...So it was as they said. Summoned with the same methods used by the beast tribes and taught by the Ascians.
TEXT_GAIUSE117_01191_MINFILIA_000_032: Though unfortunate, this incident did at least serve to remind the Elder Seedseer of our usefulness. Her offer of additional support could not have come at a better time. My thanks, .
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_000: Owing to the tireless efforts of all concerned, we are, at long last, ready to bid farewell to Vesper Bay.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_001: So as to avoid drawing undue attention, we shall make the journey to Revenant's Toll in small groups, departing at irregular intervals.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_002: Lest you doubt, it is still my intention to conduct future operations openly, but on this particular occasion, the need for caution overrides all other concerns. To move north as one ponderous caravan would only serve to invite attack.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_003: It seemed only right that I should be the last to leave, and I would have you remain with me until the end, .
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_004: Upon my departure, the Waking Sands will formally cease to be our headquarters, and the premises will be given into the care of Urianger.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_005: I had thought to relinquish the property, but he was quite adamant, and I had not the heart to disagree. These walls have borne witness to some of the brightest...and darkest moments in our order's history. Mayhap it is best that we do not forsake them entirely.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_006: Urianger shall remain here and devote his energies to studying the nature of primals. By the grace of the Twelve, he will one day discover the permanent solution that we have sought for so long.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_007: Of course, he will not be alone─Alisaie shall continue to work closely with him as well.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_008: Should they require our assistance, I have their assurances that they will not hesitate to contact us.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_009: Speaking of Urianger─would you inquire of him if any tasks remain undone? I cannot escape the feeling that I have forgotten something. Something important.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_010: Thou art ever welcome, , but I require no assistance. Pray take thy leave unburdened by concern for my well-being.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_011: Verily, thy countenance bespeaks a desire to quit this place without further delay. Hm. Mayhap thou thinkest this chapter of our tale concluded─that these halls should rightly be consigned to the annals of history...?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_012: In man's eagerness to seize the future, how readily he doth set down the past.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_013: Full many a proud pioneer hath bravely stridden into the great unknown, only to find there the banner of his ancestor, faded by the eons. And still man glorieth in his discoveries. 'Tis through his pride that wisdom doth ever give way to ignorance, while they who lurk in shadow remain hidden, lost no sooner than they are found.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_014: <sigh> Be not offended, . Thy conduct hath ever been beyond reproach. Despite thy surpassing strength, and all thy many victories, thou hast never been so convinced of thine own greatness as to imagine thyself above the failings of thy forebears. Mayhap it is the Echo which hath opened thine eyes to the lessons of history. Would that the same could be said of─
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_021: Whence came that cry!? The solar! Twelve forfend─the Antecedent!
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_030: Tell me, Louisoix... Would you have done the same?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSANCIENT_000: (-???-)...Louisoix Leveilleur was a remarkable man. Wise beyond mortal measure. Would that I had met him prior to his passing.
(-???-)How readily you see. You are indeed gifted, Antecedent.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_034: But you... You are not like the others. Your robes...
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSANCIENT_000: (-???-)Gifted─but ignorant. Yet I shall not judge you harshly. The fault lies with your forebears. It has been...millennia.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSEORZEA_000_: (-???-)Mine are the robes of an emissary. Unlike he who came before, I have no quarrel with you.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_037: He who─ You speak of Lahabrea?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSEORZEA_000_: (-???-)Lahabrea is a warrior. He fought. He fell.
(-???-)He may yet learn from his mistakes.
(-???-)Come. I only confirm that which you already knew.
(-???-)There is no cessation, no oblivion. Only expulsion.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_TATARU_000_044: We're ready when you are, my lady! If there's nothing else...
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_TATARU_000_046: Ah...I feel the same way. After everything that's happened here, it feels strange to leave. But I'm sure we'll soon get used to Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_TATARU_000_047: Well...I'll let you say your good-byes. Take as long as you like, my lady. We shall depart whenever you're ready.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSEORZEA_000_: (-???-)It is only to be expected. She lacks the gift and the knowledge both. To her, we are indistinct.
(-???-)Shadowless, fleshless, formless... What truth there is in each tale is diluted by time and telling.
(-???-)Knowledge dictates expectation, and expectation colors perception. Thus did she perceive naught.
(-???-)So it is with all but a chosen few. Even you, when young, could not yet see with eyes unclouded.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_053: You know nothing about me. Nothing.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSEORZEA_000_: (-???-)The gift grants you clarity; it grants you focus. With it, you may in time come to see us as we are, rather than this crude approximation.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_055: Lahabrea did not think so highly of the Echo.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSEORZEA_000_: (-???-)Lahabrea is wrong about a great many things. The Echo is indeed a gift─albeit one you have yet to master.
(-???-)There would be no strife between our peoples─for we would be of one mind.
(-???-)I leave, as I came, in peace, Antecedent. May we meet again as friends.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSANCIENT_000: (-???-)Mayhap I was indelicate... 'Tis a mercy She shields Her children from His grace with such resolve.
(-???-)Was it also by Her hand that you survived the Ardor, I wonder?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_070: <groan> I...I take it there is no need to explain.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_071: Save your concern. He did me no lasting harm. Whatever his intention was, it was not to kill.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_TATARU_000_072: I heard a cry! What happened!? Are you all right?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_TATARU_000_073: You look faint─do you need to lie down? I could fetch you a flask of my special tonic─
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_074: Urianger, send word to the Students of Baldesion. Tell them to scour the archives─the forbidden tomes in particular.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_075: If there is any reference to an Ascian robed in white, however oblique, I would know of it.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_076: ...An Ascian, my lady? Was that what gave you cause to cry out?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_077: I did but moments ago glimpse a figure clad in white set forth from the Waking Sands. Yet Ascians are wont to employ teleportation magicks─why would one be so brazen?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_078: I know not and care not. Find him, ! Turn every stone in Vesper Bay if you have to!
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_090: He speaks of peace, but I know his words belie his true intent.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_TATARU_000_095: Tell me he's gone, . Tell me we're safe. We are safe, aren't we...?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_100: What this visitation doth portend, I cannot say. But that thou must pursue the Ascian is clear. Scour thee Vesper Bay for signs of his passing. And fear not for the Antecedent's well-being─should the fiend be so imprudent as to return to the Waking Sands, he shall not find us unprepared a second time.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSEORZEA_000_: (-???-)Approach when you will. I shall wait.
(-???-)I am told that you are the Warrior of Light. But I would know for myself.
(-???-)I shall walk north, and you may choose to follow.
(-???-)Know, however, that you will be waylaid if you do─you may even perish. Should you survive, we shall speak anon.
(-???-)I see you live. Good. But your trial is not yet at an end.
(-???-)Remarkable. Truly remarkable. I thank you for granting me this indulgence.
(-???-)None save  who bested Lahabrea could endure such an examination.
(-???-)Have the laws of man grown so twisted in my absence that it is now permitted to lay hands upon an emissary?
(-???-)You bore witness to my audience with the Antecedent, did you not? Then you know I acted only in self-defense.

(-???-)I realize the same cannot be said of Lahabrea. Even amongst his brethren, he is considered...unique. Nevertheless, I cannot wholly condemn his misdeeds, for through them we discovered you─one so strong in the gift that  could cast us out.
(-???-)Your Mother favors you still, that much is plain. But surely you must feel it? Her influence wanes, and Her strength shall soon be spent.
(-???-)These lands, these people, this world─all shall soon change.
(-???-)As it was, so shall it be again. As it should always have been.
(-???-)Doubt my claims and question my motives if you will.
(-???-)Only believe me when I say this...
(-Elidibus-)I am Elidibus, emissary─bearer of the word of the one true god. And we shall meet again.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_140: Thank the gods you've returned, ! After you left, I began to worry that I might have sent you to your doom. I take it our visitor proved elusive?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_141: Beg pardon? He was waiting for you!? What did you do? What did he say?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_142: "As it was, so shall it be again“? ...Of when does he speak? And of what, exactly?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_143: The words of this Elidibus portend much but reveal nothing─save perhaps a measure of disdain for Lahabrea.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_144: <sigh> I had hoped for answers, but it seems I shall have to be content with a wealth of additional questions.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_TATARU_000_150: Where were you, !? Did you find the man in white? Oh, what am I doing─the Antecedent is waiting for you!
