TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_URIANGER_000_025: Thou hast been summoned to the Rising Stones, yes? Then keep not thy fellows waiting.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_026: Ah, there you are. Your friends are waiting for you inside.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_100: Oh, ! You're here! Good, good. We were all wondering when you'd show up!
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_101: As I was just telling your restive receptionist here, I'm pleased to inform you that all the documents have been prepared and all signatures signed. The Rising Stones is officially yours!
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_102: Splendid! From this day forward, I will spare no effort in seeing that it is as welcoming and comfortable a home for us as the Waking Sands ever was!
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_103: That said, this is all somewhat intimidating, is it not? So many unfamiliar places, and unfamiliar faces...
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_110: Take that odd-looking fellow over there, for example. He's been eyeing us most suspiciously ever since we arrived. I cannot help but wonder if we are truly safe here...
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_111: Ah, that man. I can't say I've spoken to him myself, but rumor has it he's come to hunt for ancient treasures in the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_112: You've seen the structure I speak of, no? It'd be hard to miss it. That massive pillar of shining crystal that looms high over the land just to the southeast of here.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_113: If the tales are to be believed, it's a remnant of some ancient civilization. The details remain a mystery, and that's no doubt why it's drawn adventurers and scholars from all over looking to unearth its secrets.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_114: The man over there is no exception─and if my instincts are true, he knows more than most. If you're curious about the tower yourself, you could do worse than to talk to him and see what he knows.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_115: Why, if I weren't otherwise occupied with my duties here, I'd have half a mind to join you. I mean, just look at it! I can scarce begin to imagine what wonders lie inside...
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_120: Revenant's Toll is populated mostly by adventurers, which means─as you might expect─that there's quite a bit of coming and going.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_121: Emphasis on the coming─at least of late, what with the investigation of the Crystal Tower hitting full stride. I've lost track of how many fortune-seekers and scholars have shown up in the past few days alone, hoping to unearth ancient secrets.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_122: I don't suppose the tower's piqued your interest as well?
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_123: You've already offered your aid to the effort, you say? You certainly move quickly, my friend.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_124: If I weren't otherwise occupied with my duties here, I'd have half a mind to join you. Alas, I'll have to settle for hearing the tales of all you've seen upon your return. Be safe in there, yes?
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_130: Most of the men and women you see around you here in Revenant's Toll are adventurers who come and go as they wish. I daresay that should make it easier for you to go about your business here.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_131: And it shouldn't hurt that  here has already made something of a name for  here. Isn't that so, ?
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_140: Why, that's wonderful to hear! Rest assured that this receptionist will work just as hard to see that our efforts do not skip a beat despite the relocation.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_141: And with that, , I do believe it's time you officially announced your presence to everyone inside.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_142: The Antecedent and the others will surely be overjoyed to see you.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SYSTEM_000_116: The Crystal Tower quest series is now available from the outlandish man.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SYSTEM_000_117: In order to progress in the main scenario, you must first complete certain quests in the Crystal Tower series.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SYSTEM_000_118: While you are granted a respite from your duties as a Scion, use your time to probe the depths of the Crystal Tower and see what ancient secrets may be gleaned!
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SYSTEM_000_125: In order to progress in the main scenario, you must first complete certain quests in the Crystal Tower series.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SYSTEM_000_126: While you are granted a respite from your duties as a Scion, use your time to probe the depths of the Crystal Tower and see what ancient secrets may be gleaned!
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_150: Welcome to our new home─the Rising Stones! Isn't it lovely?
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_151: But why are you standing around here talking to me? Everyone's waiting for you inside!
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_000: Truly, there is no rest for the weary. Scarce had I begun to make myself at home when I received a request for assistance from Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_001: It would appear their storehouse in Horizon has been the target of a series of covert robberies.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_002: Minor as they seemed in isolation, occasional discrepancies in the manifests were long dismissed as clerical errors. It was only during the Concern's annual audit that a pattern became apparent...
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_003: Significant quantities of crystals─and only crystals─were missing.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_004: I need hardly tell you what that may imply.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_005: The Brass Blades charged with investigating the thefts believe that someone within the Concern is selling the crystals for profit. Alas, they have as yet been unable to identify a likely suspect, and the Concern's proprietors have grown frustrated by their lack of progress.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_006: Needless to say, I would not have agreed to intervene had the stolen goods been of merely monetary value. If there is even a possibility that the thief acts not out of self-interest but in service to a primal, we can ill afford to wait for the Blades to realize their mistake.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_007: Pray depart for Horizon at your earliest convenience.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_008: Rendezvous with Y'shtola when you arrive. She and Thancred have already begun a preliminary investigation.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_009: I have every confidence that the three of you will get to the bottom of these thefts. I only hope our fears prove unfounded when you do.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_010: When you arrive in Horizon, be sure to speak with Y'shtola. She will inform you as to the latest developments. For my part, I shall continue to speak with the Concern's representatives. They may have additional information which could be of use.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_YSHTOLA_000_010: Ah, . Your assistance is most welcome.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_YSHTOLA_000_011: I have already spoken at length with the Brass Blades of the Rose─albeit to little avail. It would seem that the thieves took great pains to conceal their activities.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_YSHTOLA_000_012: I could go into further detail, but your time might better be spent in conversation with Fufulupa. He is the officer charged with leading the investigation, and I would only be repeating that which he related to me. If aught eluded my attention, mayhap it will not elude yours.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_FUFULUPA_000_021: Terrible business, these thefts. We have yet to confirm the quantity of crystals stolen, but I daresay it may be greater than─
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_FUFULUPA_000_022: Ah, but never mind that! I have news to share! A short while ago, the driver of a heavily laden carriage refused to halt for inspection and broke through one of our checkpoints on the Royal Allagan Sunway.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_FUFULUPA_000_023: The cart bolted off toward eastern Thanalan, where─thank the gods─I hear that our colleagues were able to apprehend them without further incident.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_YSHTOLA_000_024: ...A speeding carriage? That would seem a curious choice for thieves of such proven cunning. Yet the Amalj'aa do have a foothold in eastern Thanalan. Hmmm.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_YSHTOLA_000_025: And what of their cargo? Did they carry the crystals we seek?
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_FUFULUPA_000_026: We should be receiving a report any moment now, but I fail to see what else it could─
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_027: Did you miss me, friends? I'm back, but I fear I come bearing disappointing news. Or, on second thought, perhaps it's good news, after all...
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_YSHTOLA_000_028: ...Thancred. Wherever have you been off to?
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_029: I figured you had everything under control here, so I just took a brief excursion to the east to check up on our Amalj'aa friends.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_030: And wouldn't you believe it? I happened upon a runaway carriage on the way, and even was able to do my small part to help my friends in the Brass Blades intercept it.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_031: In all my years, I have never seen such a prodigious quantity of somnus. The Blades were calling it one of the greatest hauls they've ever seen. The stolen crystals, on the other hand, were nowhere to be found.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_FUFULUPA_000_032: Is that so? Alas...I suppose we have no choice but to resume our search elsewhere.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_033: We should reassess our options as well. Come with us, .
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_YSHTOLA_000_040: ...And so we find ourselves back where we began. <sigh> What have I overlooked...?
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_050: Against all expectation, it would seem the Amalj'aa are innocent of this particular spate of crimes. By all indications, they have yet to replenish the stores of crystals exhausted during their last attempt to summon Ifrit.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_051: What I can't fathom is why anyone else would go to such lengths to obtain crystals─and in such quantities.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_052: It cannot be that we are dealing with simple thieves. If their motive were profit, why would they limit their trade to crystals alone...? Plainly, we are missing something.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_053: While you think about what it might be, I shall inform Urianger of our progress─or lack thereof.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_000: As Lord Lolorito goes, so goes the Syndicate...
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_YUGIRI_000_000: My people could not endure another long sea voyage. But if Ul'dah will not accept us, what choice have we?
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_KASASAGI_000_000: “Prone to violence and criminal activity”!? Who is he to speak of us thus? Are we to be punished for sins we may never commit?
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_KIKYOU_000_000: Did they not hear Lady Yugiri's pleas? How can they turn us away, knowing what we have endured?
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_TELEDJIADELEDJI_000: It bears repeating that Lord Lolorito does not speak for the Syndicate.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_TELEDJIADELEDJI_100: The others harbor doubts, I will allow, but in time they shall see the error of their ways.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_RAUBAHN_000_000: As you observed, Lolorito is not afraid to speak his mind─nor is he like to change it.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_RAUBAHN_000_001: Oft have I wondered how a man so skilled at weighing the worth of things should be so incapable of seeing the value in people...
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_RAUBAHN_000_002: Bah. I will waste no more words on him─not when the Domans are yet in need of aid. Everyone, follow me to the Hall of Flames.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Hmm... Mayhap I should have considered the likelihood of failure more deeply beforehand.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_YUGIRI_000_010: A galleon is no place for my people─for any people─to call home. This cannot continue.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_KASASAGI_000_010: Is there naught we can do to earn the approval of these Ul'dahns?
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_KIKYOU_000_010: We do not wish to live by the grace of others. We want to work; we want to contribute!
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_TELEDJIADELEDJI_000: I will not deny that certain portions of the refugee population have been a burden on the sultanate─but I take issue with my counterparts' contention that they account for the majority. In this they are plainly mistaken. Even so, we must not think ill of them for wishing to protect our great nation.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_RAUBAHN_000_011: The Syndicate has spoken, and I see no point in moving that the matter be reconsidered. The Monetarists have made their position clear.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Agreed. Ul'dah is not an option.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Nor are Limsa Lominsa or Gridania, I judge, given the state of their internal affairs.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Which leaves our Doman friends confined to a ship. Gods, the thought of them huddled in an airless hold with no hope of better treatment...
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Would that I had more time to find an alternative! A place not bound by the concerns of the great nations─
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_016: Minfilia. ...That is precisely what I wished to discuss.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_YUGIRI_000_017: I understand the Syndicate's decision, I do. We all wish to preserve that which is ours, especially when we believe it to be under siege.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_YUGIRI_000_018: But I cannot meekly accept this judgment─not while my people suffer. Would it be out of the question for the sultanate to accept us for a limited time? A week, mayhap, or even just a few days...?
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_019: Excellent. I shall keep you informed.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Lady Yugiri, I have a proposal, if you would hear it.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_022: The headquarters of my order, the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, stands in a place called Revenant's Toll, an outpost in Mor Dhona.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Like most outposts, it is frequented by mercenaries and other men of action, and lacks the comforts of more well-established settlements. However, the leaders of Revenant's Toll have been doing their utmost to change that.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_024: To that end, they have need of able-bodied individuals willing to work as frontier hands. Hard labor, lest you doubt, with naught save food and shelter by way of reward.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_RAUBAHN_000_025: Terms not unlike those which you yourself proposed, Lady Yugiri.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_TELEDJIADELEDJI_000: Though I will not hear a word said against our beloved Ul'dah, Revenant's Toll would offer certain advantages─the absence of unhelpful bureaucracy being the most obvious.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_YUGIRI_000_027: If they can accommodate us all, we shall gladly accept!
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_YUGIRI_000_028: Master Alphinaud, once again I find myself in your debt.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_029: Pray do not thank me, my lady. The life your people go to is one of hard labor and few comforts, as I told you. And before that, there remains the matter of how they may safely be borne to Revenant's Toll─which will be no small feat, considering the distance and their present condition.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Mayhap the Ul'dahn Adventurers' Guild can be of assistance. Look for me there anon, .
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_RAUBAHN_000_031: Lady Yugiri, if you and your people would accompany me, we may discuss what aid the Immortal Flames can provide.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_040: We are concerned that the Doman refugees may find the journey to Revenant's Toll too much to bear.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Too long have they been sequestered aboard their ship, with insufficient supplies and scarce room enough to breathe, let alone stretch their limbs. With that in mind, Mistress Momodi has kindly offered to accommodate the Domans until such time as they are ready to set out for Mor Dhona.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_042: Those healthy enough to travel will embark as soon as transportation has been secured, while those too weak to leave at once will be permitted to stay until they regain their strength.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_044: Transportation remains our greatest obstacle, General. Is there aught the Immortal Flames can do?
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_RAUBAHN_000_045: I fear that exceeds our mandate.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_RAUBAHN_000_046: Were it a smaller number, mayhap it would go unnoticed.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_RAUBAHN_000_047: But the Syndicate will not bear the cost of escorting more than two hundred Domans to Mor Dhona.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_TELEDJIADELEDJI_000: When government fails to act, the responsibility falls to us private citizens.
I will engage the services of the Seventy-Seven Caravans on the Domans' behalf.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_RAUBAHN_000_050: Very well─we should begin contract negotiations at once. Your generosity is most welcome, my lord.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_TELEDJIADELEDJI_000: After all that has befallen these good people, it is the least I can do.
Come what may, you shall ever have a friend in Ul'dah, Lady Yugiri.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_YUGIRI_000_053: And you in Revenant's Toll, my lord.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_MOMODI_000_054: Well, it sounds like we all have work to do! Lady Yugiri, let's put our heads together an' settle the details of our arrangement, shall we?
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_055: I would entrust the task of escorting our Doman friends to you─after you have rested your own road-weary legs, of course. What say you?
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_ALPHINAUD_000_000: As we speak, the Domans prepare for departure at Vesper Bay, wherefrom they will be transported by carriage to Ul'dah.
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_ALPHINAUD_000_001: That said, this has all been decided rather suddenly, and it would not surprise me if the refugees required some assistance in coordinating their preparations.
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_ALPHINAUD_000_002: , I would have you return to Vesper Bay and facilitate the process through tasks great and small. In short: whatever must needs be done, do it.
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Speak with a man named Hozan when you arrive. As Lady Yugiri tells it, he has been designated the leader of the first group.
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_ALPHINAUD_000_005: I know that these tasks may seem trifling at times. However, they are vital to ensuring the safety of the refugees for their pending journey.
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_HOUZAN_000_010: Greetings. Alphinaud informed me that a Scion would be arriving to help with the preparations. I am honored to meet you, though shamed as well. A great warrior should not be tasked with such trivialities.
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_HOUZAN_000_011: Aye, I knew from a glance what manner of  you were. I too have some skill at arms, as do many of our people.
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_HOUZAN_000_012: Pray forgive this trifle, but might I trouble you to help round up the children that have been given into my care?
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_HOUZAN_000_013: They are most adept at staying hidden from my sight, but perhaps your keen eyes will succeed where I have failed.
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_HOUZAN_000_014: You have my thanks, friend. Pray seek out my son Yozan. He can tell you more.
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_HOUZAN_000_020: These have been trying times, but Yozan has handled himself well. I only wish there were more I could do for him.
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_YOUZAN_000_030: Oh, hello there! I'm Yozan, son of Hozan. Will you be coming with us to Ul'dah? I hear we're traveling by horsebird-drawn carriage!
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_YOUZAN_000_031: But...don't you think they're queer? Giant birds that people ride like horses? I still want to try riding one, but─
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_YOUZAN_000_032: What's that? You're looking for the others? Don't worry. I already told them to get ready for the carriages.
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_YOUZAN_000_033: I'll need your help, though. We were just finishing a game of hide-and-seek. Three players are still in hiding, and since Lady Yugiri told us to take it really seriously, they won't move until they're found. But Vesper Bay isn't that big, so I bet you can find them in no time!
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_KOHARU_000_040: Hey! You're not Yozan! Who're you?
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_KOHARU_000_041: (-Koharu-)I'm Koharu. , eh? I didn't know anyone else was─ Waaait a minute! You're one of those, um, Stallions, aren't you!?
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_KOHARU_000_042: (-Koharu-)No─ Scions, Scions! Then you must know Lady Yugiri, right? Isn't she great!? She's really good at hide-and-seek, too! Oh, right─ It's almost time to go. Nice meeting you, !
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_CHILD01350A_000_050: How'd you find me!? Bah! Guess I need to practice more.
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_CHILD01350A_000_051: Or maybe you're just good at this? I mean, the Garleans didn't find me...
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_CHILD01350B_000_060: Um... Are you playing? Ahhh! No fair! Yozan didn't say anything about adults!
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_CHILD01350B_000_061: Huh? We get to ride a horsebird carriage? I don't know... It sounds scary. But if Yozan says it's safe, I'll go.
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_HOUZAN_000_070: Wonderful! All the children are accounted─ Hide-and-seek? Ah, I see that you are curious. It is quite simple, really.
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_HOUZAN_000_071: Lady Yugiri thought it best that the children know what to do in case the Garleans found us.
TEXT_XXAUSE206_03881_HOUZAN_000_072: I should hope that those days are behind us, but I nevertheless take comfort in knowing that we are prepared.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_ALPHINAUD_000_000: It is past time Lady Yugiri met with the guild representatives in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Since I do not foresee any further matters arising here in Thanalan which might require your personal attention, I would instead have you serve as an escort to the Doman delegation for the duration of the journey.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Speak first with Slafborn upon your arrival. He is the one with whom the Domans will be working most closely, I should think.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Afterwards, introduce Lady Yugiri to Minfilia and the guild emissary. If both meetings go well, the resulting ties should stand the Domans in good stead for that which is to come. Safe travels, .
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_YUGIRI_000_005: We are ready to depart at your earliest convenience. But say the word and we shall follow.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_KSASAGI_000_005: Many great and terrible beasts roam the wastes of Mor Dhona, yes? Then we must needs keep a closer eye on the children.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_KIKYOU_000_005: I hope this proves to be the final leg of our journey... The malms have taken their toll.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_SLAFBORN_000_010: And this must be the esteemed Lady Yugiri and her associates. I greet you all as friends, and bid you welcome to the Toll.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_SLAFBORN_000_011: I hope you do not find our dearth of fineries off-putting. Poor though we may seem, we have a wealth of spirit─and camaraderie to spare!
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_SLAFBORN_000_012: You see, race and creed don't enter into it here. We welcome all sorts─provided they are willing to earn their keep, of course.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_YUGIRI_000_013: We are no strangers to hard work, Master Slafborn. You may rest assured that we will carry out your orders with due diligence.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_SLAFBORN_000_014: Oh, not for a moment did I doubt your commitment, my lady! Pray understand, I give the same speech to all new arrivals. And you needn't bow your head or call me “Master” either. We are both frontier hands, as far as I'm concerned.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_YUGIRI_000_015: As you wish...Slafborn. May this meeting mark the beginning of a long and fruitful relationship.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_SLAFBORN_000_016: Our guests have yet to meet the Antecedent? Seven hells, , why are you wasting time with me!? See them to the Rising Stones!
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_KSASAGI_000_018: The sentries appear more than capable... Even so, it may be best to forbid people from venturing beyond the walls unescorted─for the time being, at least.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_KIKYOU_000_018: At long last, we have an opportunity to prove our worth. You shan't regret this, .
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_YUGIRI_000_020: To whom much is given, much is expected...
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_YUGIRI_000_021: Forgive me─I require a moment to compose my thoughts before meeting with your leader. We shall join you at the Rising Stones anon.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_YUGIRI_000_025: The Rising Stones is in the Seventh Heaven, yes? We shall follow anon.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_MINFILIA_000_031: Our attempts to reach the Students of Baldesion continue to meet with failure. Urianger has explored other avenues of inquiry, but they too have yielded naught.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_MINFILIA_000_032: We will persevere, of course...yet within our hearts, the truth is clear. We are but awaiting confirmation of that which we already know.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_MINFILIA_000_033: How fare the Domans? I am given to understand you were kept quite busy in Vesper Bay.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_MINFILIA_000_034: Mayhap you question the wisdom of aiding refugees when the primal threat remains unresolved.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_MINFILIA_000_035: I should not blame you if you did. Nor would I deny that this matter falls outside our normal purview. Be that as it may, I could not ignore the plight of these refugees─not when it was within our power to help them.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_MINFILIA_000_036: Lady Yugiri is here? Please, show her in. I should very much like to meet her.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_MINFILIA_000_037: We have no objections. Pray do so with our blessing.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_YUGIRI_000_038: Your answer pleases me beyond words, my lady─but are you quite certain? We have no way of knowing how many might answer my summons.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_YUGIRI_000_039: In the event that Revenant's Toll could not accommodate us all, we would need to find an alternative solution.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_MINFILIA_000_040: Should that come to pass, we will find it together.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_SISHA01353_000_041: As ever, it has been a pleasure, Antecedent. Alas, we must take our leave as the first carriages are due to arrive at any moment.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_SISHA01353_000_042: Should you require aught else, pray speak with Slafborn. Lady Yugiri, .
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_MINFILIA_000_050: Lhaminn and I will make all the necessary preparations to ensure that our Doman friends feel at home upon their arrival.
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_MINFILIA_000_051: Though I must admit that I am still troubled about the matter of the missing crystals...
TEXT_XXAUSE211_03882_MINFILIA_000_052: Y'shtola should be returning anon with a report from afield. Mayhap you could wait here and speak with her upon her arrival?
TEXT_XXAUSE303_03883_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSE303_03883_TREMBLEMAN01443_000: The other refugees are hiding in the caves south of Lost Hope, but to approach them would be fruitless. They would sooner call us agents of the sultanate and try to kill us than listen to reason. Why, the twins might even deign to do the deed themselves.
A pox on all bloody sellswords! They were supposed to train us to fight, but the ones he sent with us vanished during the struggle.
Oh, if only we had never listened to that merchant's ridiculous claims! He said our cause was righteous, that the gods would never suffer us to be defeated─

Though, if they were forced to confront reality... That's it! Challenge the twins to combat and show my brethren that their strongest warriors are no match for one ! Mayhap then they will agree to lay down their arms and renounce this plot!
Hurt the twins if you must, but pray do your utmost not to harm the others.
TEXT_XXAUSE303_03883_REFUGEE01444_000_02: Seven hells, they've found us! Everyone, grab yer gear and make for the rendezvous point!
...So that's yer game, is it? Ahahaha! Sorry to disappoint ye, , but we're more than willin' to kill ye ourselves!
TEXT_XXAUSE303_03883_REFUGEE01444_000_03: Ye beat 'em like it was nothin'! Thal almighty, what are we gonna do now...?
We yield, all right!? We yield! That's what ye wanted, ain't it!? So go away and leave us be!
TEXT_XXAUSE303_03883_TREMBLEMAN01443_000: You've returned! Did you find my brethren? What of the twins? What happened!?
I see... Well...you had no choice. Better that a handful of them take a beating from you than the lot get butchered by the Flames.
Tell me, what did the merchant have to say when it was over?
Huh? But where else would he be? Unless... Unless he went to Stonesthrow to recruit others?
TEXT_XXAUSE303_03883_BALLOON_000_010: You should never have come here!
TEXT_XXAUSE303_03883_BALLOON_000_060:
You won't stop us!
You can't stop us!
TEXT_XXAUSE304_03884_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSE304_03884_TREMBLEMAN01443_100: The merchant wished to approach the refugees in Stonesthrow, but was waiting until the Flames withdrew their forces from the vicinity. Now that they have, there's nothing to stop him from continuing his work.
How many more must perish in pursuit of this futile cause? How much more suffering must we endure before it ends?
Find him. Convince him to cease his mad quest. It will surely lead us to ruin.
TEXT_XXAUSE304_03884_ELE_100_010: <sniffle> Have... Have you seen my parents?
TEXT_XXAUSE304_03884_ELE_100_011: They told me to stay here with the others. <sniffle> They said they'd be back soon, but it's been days...
TEXT_XXAUSE304_03884_ELE_100_012: They left with the man from Ul'dah. The man said they were gonna change everything─make it so we could live inside the walls with everyone else. I liked it when he said that.
TEXT_XXAUSE304_03884_ELE_100_013: I didn't like it when he talked about making the rich people pay. Everyone looked so angry, and I got scared...
TEXT_XXAUSE304_03884_A1_000_002: I'm looking for someone stirring up trouble.
TEXT_XXAUSE304_03884_ELE_000_001: You mean...the man who left with my parents? But I don't know where he─
TEXT_XXAUSE304_03884_ELE_100_001: Wait...look! Over there! I think that's him!
TEXT_XXAUSE304_03884_MERCHANT01445_000_0: Well, now. Which of these gullible fools shall be my next victim?
TEXT_XXAUSE304_03884_ELE_000_004: He's getting away! Go get him, !
TEXT_XXAUSE304_03884_ELE_000_010: The man who left with my parents ran off that way! You can't let him get away!
TEXT_XXAUSE304_03884_GUARDLEADER01445_00: Hold, adventurer. I would know more about your relationship with the victim, as well as the events leading up to his death.
This man was responsible for the recent riots? Mayhap we owe his murderer a debt of gratitude.
In any case, it is obvious you are not the one whom we seek. You may carry on with your investigation, Scion.
If that arrow was shot from where you indicated, the archer must have a good eye...and a better arm.
TEXT_XXAUSE304_03884_SWIFT_000_090: What news, ? Where is the merchant?
TEXT_XXAUSE304_03884_SWIFT_000_091: Murdered!? Damn it all to the seventh hell!
TEXT_XXAUSE304_03884_SWIFT_000_092: He was not simply murdered, ─he was silenced. Too many knew his face, and he was ready to divulge his secrets.
TEXT_XXAUSE304_03884_SWIFT_000_093: Do not despair, though. We may be closer to identifying the true orchestrator of these riots than you realize.
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_LIEUTENANT01448_000: I was told that a messenger would be sent as soon as your fellow Scions finished their investigation. I do not imagine it will be much longer.
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_MAXIO_000_001: This one returns, and returns with good tidings! Wise ones have finished searching, and have wisely identified the precise location where the touched ones summoned Lord Ramuh!
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_LIEUTENANT01448_000: Your timing is impeccable, my fluttery friend! Might you be so kind as to escort this good  to  fellow Scions?
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_MAXIO_000_003: It would be this one's pleasure, walking one. Please, please come with this one!
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_LIEUTENANT01448_000: We are counting on you, ! Be safe, and godsspeed!
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_MAXIO_000_020: Wise ones have ventured deep, deep within the Sylphlands. These ones must proceed carefully, and keep an eye out for touched ones.
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_MAXIO_000_030: This one is most sorry, but this one can go no further. Draw too close to Lord Ramuh, and this one may turn mean and nasty like touched ones!
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_MAXIO_000_031: And so this one must say farewell for now. Walking one will find wise ones not far from here, to the south. Go in safety, walking one.
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_THANCRED_000_040: Ah, there you are. It is you, isn't it?
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_YDA_000_041:
Sooo...Thancred is Thancred, Papalymo is Papalymo, Y'shtola is Y'shtola, and you are you, right? Well, that's easy enough to remember. This one's name is Yda, in case walking one was wondering.
...JOKE! I'm joking!
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_YSHTOLA_000_042: ...Don't ask. Suffice it to say that we had something of a situation here.
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_PAPALYMO_000_050: ...So it's actually you. I am relieved. For a moment, I thought we were dealing with another one of those confounded sylph tricksters.
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_PAPALYMO_000_051: I swear, with them wreaking havoc with their skin-changing magicks, it's a wonder I was able to finish taking my measurements.
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_PAPALYMO_000_052: Yes, it was quite the ordeal. You should have seen the look on Y'shtola's face when the one impersonating you suddenly showed up...
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_PAPALYMO_000_054: ...Ahem. My apologies. It's not like me to ramble so.
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_PAPALYMO_000_055: At any rate, as I was saying, I have finished measuring aetheric activity in the area, and am pleased to say I have reached an indisputable conclusion─to wit, that Ramuh was called forth in the vicinity of the sylphs' aetheryte!
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_PAPALYMO_000_056: Come, . The Lord of Levin awaits!
TEXT_XXAUSE311_03885_LIEUTENANT01448_000: , you have returned! Dare I ask how Ramuh received your visit?
...He challenged you to a test of arms!? It is well, then, that you have some experience in such matters!
The peoples of both Gridania and Little Solace will be relieved to hear that the Lord of Levin has accepted you as the forest's champion of peace.
You have performed a monumental duty this day, . The Elder Seedseer must be informed of your deeds at once!
TEXT_XXAUSE411_03886_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSE411_03886_ILBERD_000_020: Roaille is headed in the direction of the Blue Badger Gate. With me, Scion.
TEXT_XXAUSE411_03886_ROAILLE_000_030: Ahhh... The forest air is so cleansing. I feel like a new woman every time I visit Gridania.
TEXT_XXAUSE411_03886_ILBERD_000_040: So, Roaille has entered the Carline Canopy... Meeting someone, perchance? Or could it be she means to board an airship?
TEXT_XXAUSE411_03886_ILBERD_000_041: Pray look for her within. If she is not on the upper floor, try the landing area below.
TEXT_XXAUSE411_03886_ILBERD_000_042: One of mine is stationed there, and she may have seen something. Ephemie is her name. I shall remain here in case Roaille reappears.
TEXT_XXAUSE411_03886_ILBERD_000_050: Quickly now─look for Roaille inside the Carline Canopy. If she is not on the upper floor, try the landing area below. Speak with Ephemie─she may have seen something.
TEXT_XXAUSE411_03886_EPHEMIE_000_060: ! Such an unexpected pleasure! What brings you here?
TEXT_XXAUSE411_03886_EPHEMIE_000_061: Ahem. A social visit, you say? How pleasant! (No─she didn't come this way. I've noted every passenger, and none bore any resemblance.) Well, don't let me keep you!
TEXT_XXAUSE411_03886_EPHEMIE_000_070: Still no sign of your friend, I'm afraid! (And I mean that.) I do hope you find him!
TEXT_XXAUSE411_03886_ILBERD_000_080: ...Nowhere to be seen, you say? And you are sure she did not board an airship?
TEXT_XXAUSE411_03886_ILBERD_000_081: Hmph. She did not come back out, either. Where in the seven hells could she have gone...?
TEXT_XXAUSE411_03886_SHINOBI00079_000_17: (-Peddler-)Greetings, good sir. Might I interest you in some Mun-Tuy tonic? A cup a day imbues a man with great vigor, if you take my meaning. Heh heh...
TEXT_XXAUSE411_03886_ILBERD_000_176: ...Wait. That necklace─ You are a shinobi of Doma.
TEXT_XXAUSE411_03886_SHINOBI00079_000_17: The woman you seek has left Gridania by way of Westshore Pier.
She was attired as a merchant, but these eyes are not so easily deceived.
You may wish to take your search to the East Shroud. Rest assured that we shall continue to support you from the shadows.
TEXT_XXAUSE411_03886_ILBERD_000_180: Thank the Twelve for the Domans. Were it not for their unique talents, Roaille would have disappeared without a trace.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_ILBERD_000_000: Our hunt leads us to the East Shroud, Scion. I suggest we follow Roaille's example and take the ferry from Westshore Pier.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_ILBERD_000_001: You'll doubtless wish to make certain preparations. See to them while I go on ahead. I shall wait for you at Sweetbloom Pier.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_YUGIRI_000_011: Your quarry makes for the Hawthorne Hut.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_YUGIRI_000_012: If Roaille is truly the one we seek, we can expect that she means to make contact with her Garlean masters there.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_ILBERD_000_013: An explanation is in order. You are no doubt aware that the Garleans have their own method of communicating over great distances.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_ILBERD_000_014: Well, our ingenious friends at Garlond Ironworks have provided us with devices which disrupt these communications, and we have installed them around the city-states. In so doing, we have made it difficult for imperial agents to correspond with their masters.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_ILBERD_000_015: Roaille would thus have no choice but to rendezvous with her imperial contact directly. Yet, as a well-known face in the Immortal Flames, she cannot move about Thanalan without being recognized. It would only be a matter of time before someone saw through her disguise.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_ILBERD_000_016: 'Tis for this reason, I believe, that she has chosen the Black Shroud for her clandestine meeting. , and  not like to turn any heads.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_YUGIRI_000_017: As my scouts tell it, the Garleans have sent agents with a mind to destroy the devices and render such direct contact unnecessary. Fortunately, our shinobi have thus far been successful in rebuffing their efforts.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_ILBERD_100_018: ...This is it. We need only make for Hawthorne's Hut and catch Roaille in the act.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_ILBERD_000_020: If Roaille was here, she is no more. We have no choice but to continue the pursuit.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_YUGIRI_000_030: My people report that our quarry has departed for the Bramble Patch.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_ILBERD_000_031: The Ivy returns to the gnarls whence she came... But perhaps it is all for the better.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_ILBERD_000_032: To convict someone of her standing, we will require damning evidence against her. What could be better than to catch her in the act when she meets with her Garlean masters?
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_YUGIRI_000_033: My countrymen and I shall lie in wait in the shadows. Tread warily, my friends.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_YUGIRI_000_050: Even a warrior of Roaille's renown could not have hoped to escape by force. Despite her claims, her surrender does not bespeak innocence, but an awareness that her position is untenable.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_YUGIRI_000_051: With the Ivy thus uprooted, it is to be hoped that the tendrils she entwined around the Immortal Flames will gradually wither and die.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_YUGIRI_000_052: Mayhap then the people of Ul'dah will have the Grand Company they deserve. But let us speak of the present. If I may ask, what will you do now, ?
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_YUGIRI_000_053: ...So the Scions seek a way into Iceheart's sanctum.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_YUGIRI_000_054: Then I daresay you are eager to return to the Rising Stones. Pray do not let me keep you.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_YUGIRI_000_055: Fear not─my countrymen and I shall tend to the aftermath. You need not waste your talents here.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_YUGIRI_000_056: And speaking of talents, you have been training in the art of the shinobi, have you not? The change in your bearing is quite evident─to me, at least. I look forward to seeing you in action. Till next time, my friend.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_YUGIRI_000_057: And speaking of talents, have you considered training in the art of the shinobi? You have the aptitude for it, I believe, so please give it some thought. Till next time, my friend.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_MINFILIA_000_060: Welcome back, . I understand that Alphinaud had a task for you. May I ask what it was?
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_MINFILIA_000_061: Charges of treason and espionage against Eline Roaille? I can scarce believe it...
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_MINFILIA_000_062: Could there not have been some manner of misunderstanding...?
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_MINFILIA_000_064: No, it avails us naught to dwell on it. Whatever the truth may be, we must trust to the authorities to uncover it.
TEXT_XXAUSE413_03887_MINFILIA_000_065: Let us speak of another matter. I am pleased to report that we have made progress in our efforts to find a way into Iceheart's sanctum...
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Ere I forget, I believe Moenbryda has requested a gathering of the Scions. I assume there has been some progress concerning our efforts to combat the Ascians.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Pray inform her that our business with the Ishgardians is concluded for the moment─I shall be along once I've completed my communications with the Crystal Braves.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Would you be so kind as to inform Moenbryda that our Ishgardian visitor has departed? I must speak with the Crystal Braves, then I shall join you all forthwith.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_MOENBRYDA_000_010: All done with your talk of dragons? Wonderful, because Ascians are next on the menu! Let's head into the solar, shall we?
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_YDA_000_011: I'm telling you, Thancred: keep pestering Moenbryda and the only thing you'll become intimate with is her axe...
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_PAPALYMO_000_012: There have been no reports of suspicious masked men in Gridania, that is certain. Mayhaps they weave their dark plots in other lands?
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_THANCRED_000_013: Such statuesque beauty─and possessed of a mind for research to match her belly for hard liquor! What does a woman of so many charms see in musty old Urianger...?
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_YSHTOLA_000_014: I keep my senses strained for signs of Ascian activity, but there is little news to be had.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_YSHTOLA_100_014: Have their schemes reached some critical step? This silence is most disturbing...
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_MINFILIA_000_015: I've summoned everyone to the solar. 'Twould seem Moenbryda has something exciting to share with us.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_ALPHINAUD_000_016: Of all our adversaries, the Ascians could well be considered the most dangerous. I do hope Moenbryda's research has borne fruit...
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_TATARU_000_031: For a small organization, we certainly chew through a prodigious amount of foodstuffs. Perhaps I should put a lock on the larder door...
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_HIGIRI_000_032: We do seem to be running low on provisions. I believe an excursion to the marketplace is in order.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_FLHAMINN_000_033: I see that the Scions once more ready themselves for the road. I, too, must make preparations for an absence from the Rising Stones...
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_HOARYBOULDER_000_03: It seems you have barely arrived before you must once more plunge into the fray. Duty is an unforgiving mistress, eh? Though the tasks we tackle are not like to be as realm-shaking, Coultenet and I must also heed her call.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_COULTENET_000_035: Hoary was most eager to join you on the front lines of battle, but, as fate would have it, the Antecedent had other plans for our talents.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_MINFILIA_000_036: Though I have little doubt you will prevail against the Empire's forces, I shall pray for your success nonetheless. Our very future may depend upon Moenbryda being free to pursue her experiments.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_ALPHINAUD_000_050: 'Twould seem that events have once more conspired to rob us of rest and recuperation. Though I would wish it otherwise, I must ask that you head straightaway to the processing plant.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_ALPHINAUD_000_051: The 4th have already deployed to the area, and await the arrival of the Scions. Wilred will brief you on the developing situation.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_ALPHINAUD_000_052: Meanwhile, I must rendezvous with Captain Ilberd at our headquarters in Ul'dah. I shall take command of our forces there with a lighter heart, knowing that you go to support the front lines.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_HOARYBOULDER_000_06: Your duties take you to northern Thanalan, do they not?
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_COULTENET_000_061: We, too, must say our farewells to the Rising Stones for a time. F'lhaminn travels to Ul'dah, and we shall serve as her escort.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_FLHAMINN_000_062: At my daughter's behest, I go to contact certain old acquaintances in the gilded city.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_FLHAMINN_000_063: We are beset on all sides by civil unrest and imperial machinations, threatened by primals and troubled by dragons─we need all the allies we can muster.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_FLHAMINN_000_064: Many of my friends hold positions of power, you see, and it is my hope that they can be convinced to aid the Scions' cause.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_FLHAMINN_000_065: If past events have taught us anything, then we know that Eorzea must present a united front or we shall fall...
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_FLHAMINN_100_065: Ah, how extraordinary that my little Ascilia is involved in such far-reaching affairs.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_FLHAMINN_000_066: I am proud that I might now stand at her side not only as a mother, but also as a colleague.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_COULTENET_000_067: A colleague with influential connections! But I fear that Ul'dah has become a place of danger even for one so familiar with her streets.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_HOARYBOULDER_000_06: Bah! Woe betide the blackguard that so much as glares in your direction, milady!
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_FLHAMINN_000_069: Ahaha, I shall be well protected, it seems.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_COULTENET_000_070: Shall we be on our way, then?
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_ALIANNE_000_071: 'Tis unsettling to think that an enemy base lies but a brief stroll beyond these walls...
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_WILRED_000_090: Commander Leveilleur sent word that you'd be coming─a veteran of your talents is most welcome.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_WILRED_000_091: Not that I don't think we can handle the situation, mind you! I've learned a trick or two since that disaster with the Amalj'aa.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_WILRED_000_092: But returning to the task at hand...
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_WILRED_000_093: The Flames' reconnaissance scouts have reported imperial soldiers assembling at Raubahn's Push. Such a force is likely interested in only one thing: getting their hands on the resources found here at the processing plant.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_WILRED_000_094: The Garleans could begin marching on us at any time. Pray speak with Lieutenant Edelstein, that we might coordinate our counter strategy.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_WILRED_000_095: In the meantime, I will inform the others that you have arrived. No doubt it will be welcome tidings.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_EDELSTEIN_000_110: ! My soldiers yet tell tales of your deeds during Operation Archon!
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_EDELSTEIN_000_111: Would that we could sit a while and reminisce about old times...but I fear more pressing matters require our attention. The civilian draughtsmen, you see, have come across several highly suspicious crates within the boundaries of the processing plant.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_EDELSTEIN_000_112: I had my sappers take a closer look, and our worst fears were confirmed─these boxes contain powerful explosive devices. Devices of imperial design, no less.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_EDELSTEIN_000_113: By my order, the Flames stationed here are conducting a thorough sweep of the compound as we speak.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_EDELSTEIN_000_114: Though it troubles me that we were unable to apprehend the imperial spy behind this, I have faith that our men will be able to neutralize the threat for now.
TEXT_XXAUSE505_03888_EDELSTEIN_000_115: In the meantime, our scouts bring troubling news on the latest movements of the imperial army. I would once again ask for your aid.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_MARCELAIN_000_000: Ere you commit yourself to the siege, you should know what it is you are tasked with defending. Beyond the Gates of Judgement lie the Steps of Faith─a great bridge of stone that leads directly to the city of Ishgard.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_MARCELAIN_000_001: More than simply a means to cross the Sea of Clouds, the bridge serves as a foundation for the arcane wards that form the barrier we call Daniffen's Collar.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_MARCELAIN_000_002: Alas, in dispelling the barrier's outermost layer, that thrice-damned witch Iceheart stripped the bridge of its protection, and thus are the dragons now able to land unhindered upon the Steps of Faith.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_MARCELAIN_000_003: Should the Dravanians succeed in destroying the remainder of the wards, the winged devils will be free to swarm within the city itself.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_MARCELAIN_000_004: Needless to say, we cannot suffer that to happen. It shall be our task as defenders to prevent any harm from coming to those parts of the bridge wherein the wards are sealed.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_MARCELAIN_100_004: Three yet remain, and we have dispatched our forces accordingly. I would ask you and your comrades to accompany our defenders at the outermost ward.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_THANCRED_100_004: (-???-)I should hope that includes us as well, yes?
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_MARCELAIN_110_004: The Scions of the Seventh Dawn!?
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_YSHTOLA_120_004: We could not well stand idly by while the Horde threatens the good people of Ishgard.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_PAPALYMO_130_004: Indeed. To do otherwise would go against all that Master Louisoix has taught us.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_PAPALYMO_135_004: As for where we may be of most assistance, I think it prudent we divide into two groups. Yda and I will join the rear guard.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_YDA_140_004: Right! If the dragons should reach us, we'll be sure to give them what for.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_MARCELAIN_000_005: Thank you. All of you. Pray speak with me again when your preparations are complete, and together we shall stand against the Horde!
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_THANCRED_000_010: I'm told the first commander of the Temple Knights, Lucia, will be leading their forces. By all accounts, it would seem we're in quite capable hands.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_YSHTOLA_000_015: The dragons may never again have such an opportunity to strike at the Holy See. You can be certain they will not squander it, so we must be vigilant.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_PAPALYMO_000_020: Would that we could say with certainty that none of the wards will be breached, but our enemy is resourceful.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_YDA_000_025: No matter what happens, we cannot let them cross this bridge.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_SYSTEM_110_007: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 50 or above to proceed.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_MARCELAIN_100_007: I trust you are ready, then? Good. Come, let us make for the battlefield!
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_MARCELAIN_000_030: By the Fury... You have driven the Horde from the Steps of Faith! You! A stranger to our land! I confess, I did not think you capable of such a feat...
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_MARCELAIN_000_031: Yet you yielded not an ilm in the face of dragons that would turn my brother knights' blood to ice. The Fury Herself must walk at your side!
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_CHAUNOLLET_000_032: Nay, I'll not deny it: without your skill and fortitude, the city would now be ash. Would that more of your adventuring brethren possessed such qualities.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_LOANNE_000_034: You have served us well, adventurer─the Temple Knights would have been hard-pressed indeed to turn back the Horde alone. Mayhap 'tis time I returned to the practice yard...
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_THANCRED_000_035: It was a close victory, but a victory nonetheless. I think we have earned a brief respite.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_YSHTOLA_000_036: 'Tis a rare opportunity to find oneself confronted with so terrible a foe. Rarer still to emerge victorious. I should hope we need not contend with more of Nidhogg's champions.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_PAPALYMO_000_037: The famed dragoons of Ishgard commanding the skies of battle was truly a sight to behold.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_ALPHINAUD_000_040: ! The dragons are routed! Lest you wonder, the fighting at the Steel Vigil was also fierce, but my Crystal Braves were not found wanting!
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_AYMERIC_000_041: Commander Leveilleur, ... True to your word, you arrived to aid us in our hour of need.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_AYMERIC_000_042: On behalf of the Holy See and the people of Ishgard, I offer you my humble thanks.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_AYMERIC_000_043: Though I would stay and lavish you with well-deserved praise, I fear I must away to oversee the aftermath of the siege. Not all the dragons are fled, and there are yet wounded to be carried from the field. Pray let us meet anon that I might express my thanks with the proper courtesy.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_ALPHINAUD_000_044: We have indeed achieved a victory of singular importance.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_ALPHINAUD_000_045: With the Dravanian Horde thus weakened and scattered, the threat to Ishgard has been greatly diminished.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_ALPHINAUD_000_046: And, mayhap equally significant, the Holy See must now recognize the necessity of cooperation with foreign powers.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_ALPHINAUD_000_047: Long have they barred their gates against the outside world, but I am confident that the day will soon come when Ishgard proclaims itself a member of the Eorzean Alliance once more.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_ALPHINAUD_000_048: Much have we sacrificed in our struggles against dragons and primals, the Ascians and the Empire. But, step by unfaltering step, we march ever nearer to our goal.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_ALPHINAUD_000_049: And, as ever, the journey is made with you in the van.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_ALPHINAUD_000_050: The victory you have won this day gives us greater hope for the morrow.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_ALPHINAUD_000_051:
'Tis a hope that shall sustain us in the days to come, and bear us past the many evils that yet seek to hinder our progress.
Yes, we have done well, my friend, and I, for one, would take a moment to savor the enormity of our achievement!
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_ALPHINAUD_000_052: ...The demands of duty, however, allow me little time for levity. I must accompany Captain Ilberd back to Ul'dah, and reassign those Braves whose squads suffered heavy losses.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_ALPHINAUD_000_053: You, my friend, have earned a rest at the Rising Stones. Pray return to Revenant's Toll, and share your tale with Minfilia in person.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_THANCRED_000_054: We will see to informing the other nations of what took place here. Do be sure to give our regards to Minfilia.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_MINFILIA_000_061: Alphinaud sent word of the siege. And, of course, of the role you played in ending it.
TEXT_XXCUSE607_04591_MINFILIA_000_062: Your deeds never cease to amaze me, ... Thank you.
